moveCollection.Name: Air Cutter

moveCollection.Name: Amnesia

moveCollection.Name: Anchor Shot

moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon hurls an anchor towards its foe and entangles it with seaweed, the anchor drags the foe down so it cannot escape.

moveCollection.Name: Any Move

moveCollection.Name: Aqua Jet

moveCollection.Effect: Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the foe. -1 Accuracy.

moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon releases medicinal scents and vapors to refresh the user and its allies.

moveCollection.Name: Aromatic Mist

moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon showers an ally in a mist with a revitalizing armoa.

moveCollection.Name: Assist

moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon hurriedly remembers one action performed by a partner. Some Pokemon can even do what a human does and assist him with any tasks.

moveCollection.Name: Assurance

moveCollection.Description: The user retaliates against the foe, the rush of adrenaline allows it to hit harder.

moveCollection.Name: Astonish
moveCollection.Effect: Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the foe.
moveCollection.Description: The user sneaks close and startles the foe.

moveCollection.Name: Attack Order
moveCollection.Effect: High Critical. Ranged.
moveCollection.Description: The user calls upon her swarm and heeds them to charge against you. No matter where you run, they will surround you. Hope you are not allergic to bees.

moveCollection.Name: Attract
moveCollection.Effect: If Successful, Target is now In Love. This Move fails if target is from same gender as the User or genderless.
moveCollection.Description: The user makes use of its good looks and attitude to infatuate its foe.

moveCollection.Name: Aura Sphere
moveCollection.Effect: Never Fail.
moveCollection.Description: The user channels its aura and launches this power in the form of a sphere The foe's aura is hit, leaving the target unscratched but deeply hurt.

moveCollection.Name: Aura Wheel
moveCollection.Effect: If successful, Increase user's Dexterity. If the user is in “Hangry” Form this Move is considered to be Dark-Type.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon happily runs into a wheel made of electricity that strikes the foe. If the user is feeling hungry the wheel's energy is replaced by a dark aura.

moveCollection.Name: Aurora Beam
moveCollection.Effect: Roll 1 Chance Dice to Reduce foe's Strength.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon shoots a beautiful rainbow colored beam that may leave the foe flabbergasted.

moveCollection.Name: Aurora Veil
moveCollection.Effect: User and Allies will receive 1 less Damage from both Physical and Special Attacks. This move will fail if not performed under Hail Weather. Lasts until Hail Weather is over.

moveCollection.Name: Autotomize

moveCollection.Name: Avalanche
moveCollection.Effect: Low Priority 4. If the user received damage from the target this Round, Add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool.
moveCollection.Description: The user builds up a lot of snow around itself. If anything disturbs the snow, it will fall on the attacker like an avalanche.

moveCollection.Name: Baby-Doll Eyes
moveCollection.Effect: Priority 1. Reduce foe's Strength.
moveCollection.Description: Before anyone acts in battle, the user looks at the foe with the cutest eyes.

moveCollection.Name: Baddy Bad

moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon acts like a thug and channels its own dark aura as protection for itself and its allies.

moveCollection.Name: Baneful Bunker
moveCollection.Effect: Priority 4. Shield. If the foe attacked using a Physical Move, it is now Poisoned. Reduce 3 Dice from the Foe's Damage Pool.
moveCollection.Description: The user encloses itself inside its sturdy shell, which is covered by poisonous barbs. If a barb pinches the foe's skin the wound will start to fester.

moveCollection.Name: Barrage
moveCollection.Effect: Ranged. Successive Actions. -1 Accuracy.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon Throws many round objects at the target, one after the other.

moveCollection.Name: Barrier
moveCollection.Effect: Increase the User's Defense by 2.
moveCollection.Description: The user casts a protective field around itself.

moveCollection.Name: Baton Pass
moveCollection.Effect: Switcher Move. User switches out with another Pokemon. Any Attribute increase on the user is passed on the next Pokemon. The user can’t increase its Attributes again until the end of the scene.
moveCollection.Description: The user stores part of its power on a twig or a stick, anyone who touch the item will receive its might.

moveCollection.Name: Beak Blast

moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon gets ready to release a boiling gas through its beak, which gets incredibly hot. The resulting blast sounds like a train's horn.

moveCollection.Name: Beat Up

moveCollection.Description: The user calls other Pokemon to aid it in battle, together they give a beating to the foe.

moveCollection.Name: Behemoth Bash
moveCollection.Effect: If the Foe is under the effects of Dynamax, This Move becomes Lethal and you add 4 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon becomes a giant energy shield that tramples everything in its wake. If the foe is under the effects of the Dynamax phenomenon all its energy will be swept away.

moveCollection.Name: Behemoth Blade
moveCollection.Effect: If the Foe is under the effects of Dynamax, This Move becomes Lethal and you add 4 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon becomes a giant sword with a razor-sharp blade. If the foe is under the effects of the Dynamax phenomenon all its energy will be slashed to bits.

moveCollection.Name: Belch
moveCollection.Effect: The user must eat something before using this Move. -1 Accuracy.
moveCollection.Description: The user lets out a horrible belch on the target. The air contains toxins that deal a terrible damage.

moveCollection.Name: Belly Drum
moveCollection.Effect: User deals Damage to itself equal to Half of its total HP rounded down. Increase User's Strength by 3.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon Roars a war cry while hitting its Belly.

moveCollection.Name: Bestow
moveCollection.Effect: If target is not holding an Item, the User gives its own.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon respectfully offers an item, the target will take it and keep it to be polite.

moveCollection.Name: Bide
moveCollection.Effect: The User will take the next 2 hits. After those two attacks, you may use this Move again to retaliate with Strength + Twice the Damage Received from those 2 hits.
moveCollection.Description: The user endures the hit then unleashes an attack even greater.

moveCollection.Name: Bind
moveCollection.Effect: Block. Deal 2 dice of damage at the end of each Round. Lasts 4 Rounds. -2 Accuracy.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon uses its body to bind the foe, restraining and squeezing it.

moveCollection.Name: Bite
moveCollection.Effect: Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the foe.
moveCollection.Description: The user lands a vicious bite that may leave an ugly bruise.

moveCollection.Name: Blast Burn

moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon uses all of its power to deliver an infernal blast to the foe. The user is left exhausted.

moveCollection.Name: Block
moveCollection.Effect: Blocks.

moveCollection.Name: Bolt Strike

moveCollection.Effect: Target all foes in range. Roll 1 Chance Dice to Reduce the Dexterity of those affected.

moveCollection.Description: The User unleashes all of its might through a massive blast of raging fire. Although the damage is devastating the Pokemon is left unable to produce more fire for at least a day.

moveCollection.Name: Charm
moveCollection.Effect: Reduce foe's Strength by 2.

moveCollection.Name: Confuse Ray

moveCollection.Name: Court Change

moveCollection.Name: Covet

moveCollection.Name: Crabhammer

moveCollection.Name: Crafty Shield

moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon creates a magic shield to protect everyone from the bad tricks a foe might have under its sleeve. Under this shield, everyone can see dishonesty and bad intentions.

moveCollection.Name: Cross Chop
moveCollection.Effect: High Critical. -2 Accuracy.

moveCollection.Effect: Increase the Strength and Special of One Ally by 2
moveCollection.Description: Using some frosting the Pokemon decorates their target to look bigger, more powerful, and incredibly delicious!

moveCollection.Name: Defend Order
moveCollection.Effect: User Increases its Defense and Sp. Defense.
moveCollection.Description: A swarm of bugs flies around the user, creating a barrier to protect this Pokemon from damage.

moveCollection.Name: Defense Curl
moveCollection.Effect: Increase the User's Defense.
moveCollection.Description: The user curls like a ball to protect against most threats.

moveCollection.Name: Defog
moveCollection.Effect: Remove all Barriers (ie. Light Screen, Reflect), Entry Hazards (Toxic Spikes, Stealth Rock, etc.), and Terrains (Misty Terrain, Electric Terrain, etc.) from the battlefield.
moveCollection.Description: A strong current of wind that blows away any fog and even invisible barriers.

moveCollection.Name: Destiny Bond
moveCollection.Effect: If the user faints this Round due to Combat damage, the Pokemon that dealt the damage will faint at the same time.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon creates a mystical bond with anyone that causes it harm. Whatever ill falls on the user, it falls on the perpetrator too.

moveCollection.Name: Detect
moveCollection.Effect: Priority. Shield Move. Reduce 3 Damage this pokemon would receive from a Damaging Move. Negate effects of Support Moves that target the user. Reduce to zero the set damage from a move the user would take.
moveCollection.Description: The user detects the intentions of the attacker and acts out to minimize the damage.

moveCollection.Name: Diamond Storm
moveCollection.Effect: Ranged. Roll 5 Chance Dice to Increase the User's Defense by 2.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon summons a storm of diamonds over the field, these diamonds also serve as barriers the user can take cover into.

moveCollection.Name: Dig
moveCollection.Effect: Charge Move. While charging this move, the User will be out of range. Can be hit by Earthquake, Magnitude, or a similar move.
moveCollection.Description: The user digs a tunnel on the ground and attacks while coming out from below.

moveCollection.Name: Disable
moveCollection.Effect: The Target cannot use the last move it performed. Lasts 4 Rounds.
moveCollection.Description: The user hits a nerve on the foe, impeding it from performing its previous action for a short while.

moveCollection.Name: Disarming Voice
moveCollection.Effect: Sound Based. Never Fail. Targets All foes in range.
moveCollection.Description: With a charming and manipulative cry, the user deals emotional damage to its opponent. This move always makes the target feel bad.

moveCollection.Name: Discharge
moveCollection.Effect: Roll 3 Chance Dice to Paralyze those affected.
moveCollection.Description: The user releases its stored electricity in all directions.

moveCollection.Name: Dive
moveCollection.Effect: Charge Move. While charging this move, the User will be out of range. Allows the Pokemon to swim into Deep Waters.
moveCollection.Description: The user submerges into the water and continues diving at an insane speed.

moveCollection.Name: Dizzy Punch
moveCollection.Effect: Roll 2 Chance Dice to Confuse the foe. Fist Based.
moveCollection.Description: A swift punch to the jaw that spins the target and may leave it quite dizzy and disoriented.

moveCollection.Name: Doom Desire
moveCollection.Effect: Strikes at the end of the Round after the next. Bypass Shield Moves and Cover. If the target retires or switches out from battle, the damage will be dealt to the next opponent or to one of its allies. Extra effects may be added at Storyteller's Discretion
moveCollection.Description: Be careful what you wish for, this Pokemon will read your most intimate wishes and make them come true in very twisted ways.

moveCollection.Name: Double Hit
moveCollection.Effect: Double Action. -1 Accuracy.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon uses the classic 'One-Two' to attack the foe.

moveCollection.Name: Double Iron Bash
moveCollection.Effect: Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Foe.
moveCollection.Description: The user hardens its limbs and then rotates them at great speed to hit the foe twice in a row. The blow can leave the victim crushed on the floor.

moveCollection.Name: Double Kick
moveCollection.Effect: Double Action.
moveCollection.Description: The user throws two powerful kicks.

moveCollection.Name: Double Slap
moveCollection.Effect: Successive Actions. -2 Accuracy.
moveCollection.Description: The user attacks its foe with two or more slaps in the face.

moveCollection.Name: Double Team
moveCollection.Effect: The User can now make up to 5 Evasions per Round.
moveCollection.Description: The user moves rapidly around the foe, creating illusory copies of itself.

moveCollection.Name: Double-Edge
moveCollection.Effect: Recoil.
moveCollection.Description: The user recklessly slams its foe to deal a lot of damage, but it may also hurt itself in the process.

moveCollection.Name: Draco Meteor
moveCollection.Effect: Lethal. Reduce User's Special by 2. -1 Accuracy.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon calls a comet that falls from the sky to deal a brutal amount of damage. This feat demands a lot from the user.

moveCollection.Name: Dragon Ascent
moveCollection.Effect: Lethal. Reduce the user's Defense and Sp. Defense.
moveCollection.Description: The user rises above the clouds and then comes crashing down against its foe in an instant. The strike is brutal for both.

moveCollection.Name: Dragon Breath
moveCollection.Effect: Roll 3 Chance Dice to Paralyze the foe.
moveCollection.Description: The user lets out a mystical green breath that hinders the movement of anyone it touches.

moveCollection.Name: Dragon Claw
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon uses its strong claws to deliver a fierce tearing blow.

moveCollection.Name: Dragon Dance
moveCollection.Effect: Increase the User's Strength and Dexterity.
moveCollection.Description: The user performs a vigorous and mystical dance that boosts the fighting spirit and reflexes.

moveCollection.Name: Dragon Darts
moveCollection.Effect: Ranged. Double Action
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon's head is a nest for its less evolved forms, the younglings will sometimes be used as projectiles.

moveCollection.Name: Dragon Hammer
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon swings its body as a hammer and leaves the foe nailed to the cracked ground.

moveCollection.Name: Dragon Pulse
moveCollection.Description: The user opens its mouth and sends a powerful wave of energy.

moveCollection.Name: Dragon Rage
moveCollection.Effect: This moves always inflicts 2 damage.
moveCollection.Description: A dual colored flame that always leaves the same burn marks on everything it touches.

moveCollection.Name: Dragon Rush
moveCollection.Effect: Roll 2 Chance Dice to Flinch the foe. -2 Accuracy.
moveCollection.Description: The user charges rapidly against the foe. The strike may leave thetarget gasping for air.

moveCollection.Name: Dragon Tail
moveCollection.Effect: Low Priority 1. The target is hit and knocked back to its trainer, stunned. Forcing the trainer to send another Pokemon. In the wild the target is sent away. Switcher Move. -1 Accuracy.
moveCollection.Description: This Powerful tail strike can knockdown anyone up to 100 feet away!

moveCollection.Name: Drain Punch
moveCollection.Effect: Fist Based. The user restore HP equal to half the damage dealt, rounded down.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon strikes with a powerful punch. Through contact, it absorbs some vital energy.

moveCollection.Name: Draining Kiss
moveCollection.Effect: The User restores HP equal to half the damage dealt, rounded down.
moveCollection.Description: The user sends a kiss with a flirty intention, the foe catches the kiss but it ends up draining the target's energy.

moveCollection.Name: Dream Eater
moveCollection.Effect: The user restores HP equal to half the damage dealt, rounded down. The target must be asleep, this move will fail otherwise.
moveCollection.Description: The user eats the dreams of a sleeping target. When the foe wakes up, it will feel weak and empty.

moveCollection.Name: Drill Peck
moveCollection.Description: The user pierces the foe with its beak used as a drill. A dangerous move.

moveCollection.Name: Drill Run
moveCollection.Effect: High Critical.
moveCollection.Description: The user rotates its body imitating a drill and crashes against the foe. This attack may pierce through walls and floors with ease and great precision.

moveCollection.Name: Drum Beating
moveCollection.Effect: Reduce the Foe's Dexterity
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon has a perfectly good drum and you'd think it would use it. But it doesn't. It uses it's foe.

moveCollection.Name: Dual Chop
moveCollection.Effect: Double Action. -1 Accuracy.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon strikes the foe with brutal blows.

moveCollection.Name: Dynamax Cannon
moveCollection.Effect: If the Foe is under the effects of Dynamax, This Move becomes Lethal and you add 4 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon shoots a heavy projectile, if the foe is under the effects of the Dynamax phenomenon all the energy will be concentrated and explode on the target.

moveCollection.Name: Dynamic Punch
moveCollection.Effect: Fist Based. Confuse the foe. -3 Accuracy.
moveCollection.Description: A punch that hits a small pressure point. It leavers the foe disoriented.

moveCollection.Name: Earth Power
moveCollection.Effect: Roll 1 Chance Dice to Reduce the foe's Sp. Defense.
moveCollection.Description: The user sends out a subterranean wave that bursts on the ground bellow the target. It looks like the earth molds to the Pokemon's will.

moveCollection.Name: Earthquake
moveCollection.Effect: Area Attack. Ranged.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon focuses its energy into shaking the ground, everyone around will be thrown like a rag doll.

moveCollection.Name: Echoed Voice
moveCollection.Effect: Sound Based. This move can be used many times in the same Round. Add 1 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool for every consecutive time you use it. Up to 8 dice may be added this way. Reset the effect if the user performs another move, evasion, or clash.
moveCollection.Description: The user shouts loudly and the echo answers back, it will yell louder every time the echo talks back.

moveCollection.Name: Eerie Impulse
moveCollection.Effect: Reduce foe's Special by 2.
moveCollection.Description: The user radiates electricity around itself, the foe will think twice about attacking.

moveCollection.Name: Egg Bomb
moveCollection.Effect: Ranged. -2 Accuracy.
moveCollection.Description: The user throws a big egg with great force against its foe.

moveCollection.Name: Electric Terrain
moveCollection.Effect: For the Next 4 Rounds all Electric Attacks will deal 1 Extra Dice of Damage. Anyone on the ground will be cured from "Sleep" Status.
moveCollection.Description: The user electrifies the terrain, making it impossible to get a good night's sleep on it.

moveCollection.Name: Electrify
moveCollection.Effect: The Damage from the next attack made by the target will be Electric Type.
moveCollection.Description: The user hurls an electric projectile to the target, the foe is charged with electricity until it is released by the foe's next attack.

moveCollection.Name: Electro Ball
moveCollection.Effect: The user adds 1 Dice to the Damage Pool for every Dexterity point the User has that surpasses the foe's. Up to 4 Dice may be added.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon creates a small electricity orb that is hurled at the target. If the user is faster, the impact will be bigger.

moveCollection.Name: Electroweb
moveCollection.Effect: Reduce Dexterity of those affected.
moveCollection.Description: Shoots an electrified web at all foes to restrict their movement. Walking through this web can be painful.

moveCollection.Name: Embargo
moveCollection.Effect: The target cannot use its held item nor can its trainer use items on it.
moveCollection.Description: The user quickly takes out the held item of a Pokemon. It also empties the bag of the trainer and forces everyone to stay away from their own properties. Evildoers master this Move.

moveCollection.Name: Ember
moveCollection.Effect: Roll 1 Chance Dice to Burn the foe.
moveCollection.Description: The user shoots a small flame against the target that may cause a first-degree burn.

moveCollection.Name: Encore
moveCollection.Effect: For the duration of this effect, the target will repeat the exact same action sequence it had this round. Target must have had an action sequence. Last 4 Rounds. Priority 3.
moveCollection.Description: The user claps and cheers at the target to encourage it to repeat what it just did.

moveCollection.Name: Endeavor
moveCollection.Effect: Roll Damage equal to the Difference between user's Full HP and its Current HP (up to 10). User cannot reduce the target's HP to lower than its own remaining HP. Ignore foe's Defenses.
moveCollection.Description: With pure willpower, the user struggles with its foe despite the pain

moveCollection.Name: Endure
moveCollection.Effect: Priority 5. Shield Move. For the rest of the Round damaging moves can not reduce the user's HP to less then 1. Status Ailments, Weather Conditions, Recoil, Self inflicted damage can still deal damage.
moveCollection.Description: The user gets prepared to receive a fatal blow. It resists the pain despite being seriously hurt.

moveCollection.Name: Energy Ball
moveCollection.Effect: Roll 1 Chance Dice to Reduce foe's Sp. Defense.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon gathers nature's energy in a ball and hurls it at the foe. Trees and bushes may be left opaque and sad.

moveCollection.Name: Entrainment
moveCollection.Effect: The target's Ability is replaced by the User's own Ability. (ie. Luvdiscs's Swift Swim Ability will replace Geodude's Sturdy Ability).
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon dances with a catchy rhythm. The target starts dancing too and both connect to a very personal level through this performance.

moveCollection.Name: Eruption
moveCollection.Effect: Lethal. Reduce 1 Dice from the Damage Pool for every missing HP the User has. Up to 5 dice may be removed this way.
moveCollection.Description: A fierce burst of lava coming from the user at full force charring whatever comes in contact with it.

moveCollection.Name: Eternabeam
moveCollection.Effect: Lethal. Must Recharge. -1 Accuracy.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon shoots an incredibly powerful beam towards the sky. The energy released might keep traveling through space thousands of years later.

moveCollection.Name: Explosion
moveCollection.Effect: After the damage is dealt the User faints. Lethal.
moveCollection.Description: The user focuses on exploding its body, the explosion deals a massive wave of damage. A very dangerous move.

moveCollection.Name: Extrasensory
moveCollection.Effect: Roll 1 Chance Dice to Flinch the foe.
moveCollection.Description: The user attacks with an odd, almost invisible power.

moveCollection.Name: Extreme Speed
moveCollection.Effect: Priority 2. Triple the Pokemon's movement speed.
moveCollection.Description: The user charges at a blinding speed against the target.

moveCollection.Name: Facade
moveCollection.Effect: If User's got a Status Ailment (Paralysis, Poison, Burn, etc.) Add 3 Extra Dice to the Damage pool.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon will make an upfront attack. If the user is suffering, the attack will be stronger.

moveCollection.Name: Fairy Lock
moveCollection.Effect: Blocks. Last 1 Round.
moveCollection.Description: The user moves as if locking a door. It takes a few moments before everyone realizes that they are not really trapped.

moveCollection.Name: Fairy Wind
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon strikes with a wind covered in fairy dust. It causes itching.

moveCollection.Name: Fake Out
moveCollection.Effect: Priority 1. Flinch the foe. This move will only work the First Round the Pokemon is out in battle. From the second round on, it will fail automatically.
moveCollection.Description: While still preparing for battle, the user will suddenly attack the foe.

moveCollection.Name: Fake Tears
moveCollection.Effect: Reduce the foe's Sp. Defense by 2.
moveCollection.Description: The user stops battling and feigns to be crying, disrupting the foe's mood to battle and making it lower its guard.

moveCollection.Name: False Surrender
moveCollection.Effect: Never Fail.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon bows in defeat, begging for forgiveness, then backstabs its gullible foe.

moveCollection.Name: False Swipe
moveCollection.Effect: The foe can't go below 1 HP when hit by this Move.
moveCollection.Description: The user strikes the foe but lowers the power of the blow at the last second.

moveCollection.Name: Feather Dance
moveCollection.Effect: Reduce the foe's Strength by 2.
moveCollection.Description: A beautiful dance that soothes the hearts of those who watch it, reducing their aggressive intentions.

moveCollection.Name: Feint Attack
moveCollection.Effect: Never Fail.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon approaches the foe disarmingly then attacks suddenly without giving any time to react.

moveCollection.Name: Feint
moveCollection.Effect: Priority 2. This Move ignores any Shielding Move.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon feints a strike then hits for real even if the foe attempts to protect itself.

moveCollection.Name: Fell Stinger
moveCollection.Effect: If the foe faints due to damage from this attack increase the user's Strength by 2.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon stings the target. If the foe is too weakened to move it absorbs part of its power.

moveCollection.Name: Fiery Dance
moveCollection.Effect: Roll 5 Chance Dice to Increase the User's Special.
moveCollection.Description: The user cloaks itself in flames and shoots them while dancing gracefully.

moveCollection.Name: Final Gambit
moveCollection.Effect: Ignore the foe's Defenses. The user faints after dealing damage.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon puts its last strength into an all-or-nothing attack. After that, it faints.

moveCollection.Name: Fire Blast
moveCollection.Effect: Lethal. Roll 3 Chance Dice to apply Burn 3 to the foe. -2 Accuracy.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon shoots a giant fireball that explodes on contact with the foe, blasting fire in all directions.

moveCollection.Name: Fire Fang
moveCollection.Effect: Roll 2 Chance to Flinch the Foe. Roll 2 Chance Dice to Burn the foe. -1 Accuracy.
moveCollection.Description: The user breathes fire from its mouth while biting the target.

moveCollection.Name: Fire Lash
moveCollection.Effect: Reduce Foe's Defense.
moveCollection.Description: With a whip of fire, the Pokemon ensnares its foe, who is left defenseless and at its mercy.

moveCollection.Name: Fire Pledge
moveCollection.Effect: All flammable plants and objects in the battlefield are covered in flames. Roll 1 Dice of Fire Damage at the end of every Round against everyone on the field.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon chants to invoke the power of Fire. Its pledge is heard, then the flames consume everything around.

moveCollection.Name: Fire Punch
moveCollection.Effect: Fist Based. Roll 1 Chance Dice to apply Burn 2 to the foe.
moveCollection.Description: The User can ignite its fists for a brief moment without any danger of getting burned. The foe may not be so lucky.

moveCollection.Name: Fire Spin
moveCollection.Effect: Blocks. Roll 2 Dice of Damage against the foe at the end of each Round. Lasts 4 Rounds. -2 Accuracy.
moveCollection.Description: The user creates a vortex of fire that remains spinning in the battlefield, trapping the foe within.

moveCollection.Name: First Impression
moveCollection.Effect: Priority 2. This move will only work the First Round the Pokemon is out in battle. From the second round on it will fail automatically.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon makes a dramatic entrance to the battlefield, taking the foe by surprise as to who its opponent really is.

moveCollection.Name: Fishious Rend
moveCollection.Effect: If the foe has not had its Turn this Round, Add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool.
moveCollection.Description: This Pokemon uses its gills to snap at its target, even if they don't have teeth, they can have a crushing strength.

moveCollection.Name: Fissure
moveCollection.Effect: Ranged. Deal damage to the Target equal to their remaining HP plus 1 lethal damage. -5 Accuracy.
moveCollection.Description: The user tears the ground apart in a monstrous display of force. If the foe falls through the fissure it might need a rescue team to get it out.

moveCollection.Name: Flail
moveCollection.Effect: Add 1 Dice to the Damage Roll for every missing HP the user has. Up to +5 Dice may be added this way.
moveCollection.Description: The User flails and struggles to survive. The more weakened it is the stronger this attack will be.

moveCollection.Name: Flame Burst
moveCollection.Effect: After dealing damage, the user may roll 1 Dice of Damage against two other Targets.
moveCollection.Description: A concentrated flameball that bursts on contact with the foe, scattering smaller flames around.

moveCollection.Name: Flame Charge
moveCollection.Effect: Increase the User's Dexterity.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon uses its flames as propulsion to strike the foe.

moveCollection.Name: Flame Wheel
moveCollection.Effect: Roll 1 Chance Dice to Burn the foe.
moveCollection.Description: The user cloaks itself in flames and rolls to tackle the target.

moveCollection.Name: Flamethrower
moveCollection.Effect: Roll 1 Chance Dice to Apply Burn 2 to the foe.
moveCollection.Description: The user lets out a powerful fire stream that leaves a scorched trail.

moveCollection.Name: Flare Blitz
moveCollection.Effect: Recoil. Roll 1 Chance Dice to Apply Burn 3 to the foe.
moveCollection.Description: The user sets itself on fire, recklessly charging against the target with a brutal strike.

moveCollection.Name: Flash Cannon
moveCollection.Effect: Roll 1 Chance Dice to Reduce the foe's Sp. Defense.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon absorbs the reflecting light on its body, releasing a powerful beam against the foe.

moveCollection.Name: Flash
moveCollection.Effect: Reduce 1 success from all the foe's Accuracy rolls.
moveCollection.Description: The user suddenly emits a blinding light around its body, dazing its opponent in the process.

moveCollection.Name: Flatter
moveCollection.Effect: Increase the foe's Special. Confuse foe.
moveCollection.Description: The user starts flattering and admiring its opponent. It sure makes it feel good about itself, but why?

moveCollection.Name: Fleur Cannon
moveCollection.Effect: Lethal. Reduce User's Special by 2. -1 Accuracy.
moveCollection.Description: A light beam pierces the battlefield, it deals devastating damage but leaves newly grown flowers instead of scorched earth. The user is left feeling very tired.

moveCollection.Name: Fling
moveCollection.Effect: Ranged. Add up to 4 Dice to the Damage Pool, depending on the held item thrown. See P. 432 for more info.
moveCollection.Description: The usr takes its held item and throws it at the opponent. You may get it back after the fight.

moveCollection.Name: Floaty Fall
moveCollection.Effect: Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Foe. If the user of this Move is at its Final Stage of Evolution, this move fails.
moveCollection.Description: With the help of some air balloons, the user jumps up high and falls on top of its foe. The use of balloons in-battle is questionable, but the referee will allow them.

moveCollection.Name: Floral Healing
moveCollection.Effect: Basic Heal. If performed over Grassy Terrain this move is a Complete Heal.
moveCollection.Description: The user creates a flower crown that heals and relaxes its wearer. Under the right conditions this move also creates a flower patch around its target.

moveCollection.Name: Flower Shield
moveCollection.Effect: Increase the Defense of All Grass Type Pokemon on the field.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon uses a mysterious power that causes flowers to bloom beneath every Grass Pokemon nearby. Flora in this field is more resilient and beautiful.

moveCollection.Name: Fly
moveCollection.Effect: Charge Move. While charging this move the User will be out of range, with the exception of the attacks Hurricane and Thunder.
moveCollection.Description: The user flies up high in one action, then drops and strikes in the next one. The Pokemon can fly for extremely long periods of time without getting tired.

moveCollection.Name: Flying Press
moveCollection.Effect: When Dealing damage with this move, it counts as if this move was also Flying Type.
moveCollection.Description: The user flies towards the foe from the sky in pure Lucha Libre style.

moveCollection.Name: Focus Blast
moveCollection.Effect: Roll 1 Chance Dice to Reduce foe's Sp. Defense. -2 Accuracy.
moveCollection.Description: The user concentrates and releases a blast of energy.

moveCollection.Name: Focus Energy
moveCollection.Effect: All of the user's damage moves now have High Critical. This effect lasts until end of scene or the user is removed from battle.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon's energy is raised to make all strikes much more precise.

moveCollection.Name: Focus Punch
moveCollection.Effect: Fist Based. Charge Move. The User will flinch if it gets hit before releasing this attack.
moveCollection.Description: A brutal punch that requires calm and concentration

moveCollection.Name: Follow Me
moveCollection.Effect: Foes will target the user this Round. Priority 5.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon will draw everyone's attention. All foes are taunted to do their worst.

moveCollection.Name: Force Palm
moveCollection.Effect: Roll 3 Chance Dice to Paralyze the foe.
moveCollection.Description: A powerful open palm hit that knocks the foe away and may leave him unable to move.

moveCollection.Name: Foresight
moveCollection.Effect: The Foe cannot evade moves performed by the user. User's Normal and Fighting Moves can affect Ghost Types and Ghost Moves can affect Normal Types.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon uses its developed senses and mental ability to foresee the immediate future.

moveCollection.Name: Forest's Curse
moveCollection.Effect: Add the Grass Type to the Target's Type (ie. Nidoran will now be Poison/Grass Heracross will now be Bug/Fight/Grass). If the Pokemon already has a third type attached then replace it.
moveCollection.Description: The user calls the forest to lay a curse upon the target, making it grow vines and vegetation around its whole body. The curse will not be easily lifted without a medium's help.

moveCollection.Name: Foul Play
moveCollection.Effect: S.T.A.B of the user and Strength of the foe apply for this move's damage.
moveCollection.Description: The user feint attacks then tricks the foe who ends up hurting itself.

moveCollection.Name: Freeze Dry
moveCollection.Effect: Water type Pokemon are dealt 2 Extra Damage.
moveCollection.Description: The user freezes all moisture in the environment, water type Pokemon suffer greatly.

moveCollection.Name: Freeze Shock
moveCollection.Effect: Lethal. Ranged. Charge Move. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Paralyze the Foe. -1 Accuracy.
moveCollection.Description: The user appears to become a block of ice, then it releases itself from the ice with a devastating discharge. The exploding ice shards and the lightning fly all over the battlefield.

moveCollection.Name: Freezy Frost
moveCollection.Effect: If successful, remove all Increased or Reduced Attributes and Traits the Foe may have. If the user of this Move is at its Final Stage of Evolution, this move fails. -1 Accuracy.
moveCollection.Description: The user touches its foe while playing "Freeze!". Surprisingly, the foe becomes frozen on a block of ice. Once they realize they were just playing pretend the ice dissolves into haze.

moveCollection.Name: Frenzy Plant
moveCollection.Effect: Must Recharge. -1 Accuracy.
moveCollection.Description: The user roots down and calls the plants to grow in a frenzy around the foe, though it leaves the user exhausted.

moveCollection.Name: Frost Breath
moveCollection.Effect: This Move is always a Critical Hit and it gets the proper bonus for it. -1 Accuracy.
moveCollection.Description: The user shoots a gelid breath against the target that sends a chill through the spine. The sudden change of temperature can bring anyone to its knees.

moveCollection.Name: Frustration
moveCollection.Effect: Add +1 Dice to the Damage Roll for every missing point of Happiness on the User.
moveCollection.Description: A move that relies on how badly a Pokemon has been treated to make it vicious and uncaring.

moveCollection.Name: Fury Attack
moveCollection.Effect: Successive Actions. -1 Accuracy.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon goes at it with everything its got in a rather disordered way.

moveCollection.Name: Fury Cutter
moveCollection.Effect: Successive Actions.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon makes use of its claws or scythes to land as many hits as possible.

moveCollection.Name: Fury Swipes
moveCollection.Effect: Successive Actions. -1 Accuracy.
moveCollection.Description: The user swiftly uses its claws to strike the foe multiple times.

moveCollection.Name: Fusion Bolt
moveCollection.Effect: Lethal. If the Move “Fusion Flare” has already been used by anyone this Round, add 4 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool of this Move.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon strikes with a devastating electric impact, said impact will grow larger and stronger if there's a special kind of fire nearby.

moveCollection.Name: Fusion Flare
moveCollection.Effect: Lethal. If the Move “Fusion Bolt” has already been used by anyone this Round, add 4 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool of this Move
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon sets ablaze a swirling pillar upon the target, said pillar will grow taller and swirl faster if there's a special kind of charge nearby.

moveCollection.Name: Future Sight
moveCollection.Effect: Strikes at the end of the next Round. It bypasses any Shield Move and cover. If the target retires or switches out from battle the damage will be dealt to the next opponent or to one of its allies.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon foresses something terrible happening to the target. It may see images from its own future without any risk.

moveCollection.Name: Gastro Acid
moveCollection.Effect: Until the end of the Scene, eliminate any effect the foe's Ability would do.
moveCollection.Description: The user spits some of its own gastric juices, the acid prevents the foe from using its special abilities.

moveCollection.Name: Gear Grind
moveCollection.Effect: Double Action. -1 Accuracy.
moveCollection.Description: The user traps the foe between its gears and crushes it with two painful grinds.

moveCollection.Name: Gear Up
moveCollection.Effect: Increase the Strength and Special of one Steel-Type or Electric-Type Ally.
moveCollection.Description: The user engages its gears on an ally to leave the ally's body working like a welloiled machine.

moveCollection.Name: Geomancy
moveCollection.Effect: Charge Move. The user charges, then Increases by 2 its Dexterity, Special and Sp. Defense scores on its next Turn.
moveCollection.Description: Through a mystical connection this Pokemon absorbs the life force of earth itself to increase its power.

moveCollection.Name: Giga Drain
moveCollection.Effect: The user restores HP equal to half the damage dealt, rounded down.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon extracts a great amount of vital energy from the foe's body.

moveCollection.Name: Giga Impact
moveCollection.Effect: Must Recharge. Lethal. -1 Accuracy.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon strikes with a brutal force using all its body. The impact leaves the user somewhat stunned.

moveCollection.Name: Glaciate
moveCollection.Effect: Lethal. All Foes in Range. Reduce the Dexterity of those affected.
moveCollection.Description: The air is so cold it hurts to move, to see, to breath. Escaping should be your top priority, for every second you don't your life will be at peril.

moveCollection.Name: Glare
moveCollection.Effect: Paralyze the foe. -1 Accuracy.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon uses its intimidating glare to paralyze the foe with sheer terror.

moveCollection.Name: Glitzy Glow
moveCollection.Effect: If successful, for the next 4 Rounds the User and Allies will receive 1 less damage from Special Attacks. This effect does not stack. If the user of this Move is at its Final Stage of Evolution, this move fails.
moveCollection.Description: The user surrounds itself with a glamorous light, releasing it as a psychic blast, the soft glowing particles remain in the field protecting its fabulousness.

moveCollection.Name: Grapple
moveCollection.Effect: The foe is Blocked. Foe can resist this Maneuver by rolling their Strength or Dexterity score and scoring the same or more successes than the user.

moveCollection.Name: Grass Knot
moveCollection.Effect: Add 1 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool for every 50 kgs. of weight on the foe, up to +4 Extra Dice.
moveCollection.Description: The user snares the target's feet with grass, making it fall to the ground. The bigger the foe the harder the fall.

moveCollection.Name: Grass Pledge
moveCollection.Effect: Reduce the Dexterity of those affected.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon chants to invoke the power of Grass. Its pledge is heard then then soil trembles and the ground crumbles as vegetation rises to grapple anyone in the field.

moveCollection.Name: Grass Whistle
moveCollection.Effect: Sound Based. Put the Target to Sleep. -3 Accuracy.
moveCollection.Description: The user plays a beautiful and soothing melody that lulls the target into a peaceful sleep.

moveCollection.Name: Grassy Terrain
moveCollection.Effect: If successful, spend 1 Will point to activate. Everyone in the user's side of the field heals 1 HP at the end of each round. Add 1 Extra Dice to the Damage Rolls of Grass Type Moves.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon calls upon the healing power of nature to grow a patch of miraculous grass on its side of the battlefield.

moveCollection.Name: Grav Apple
moveCollection.Effect: Ranged. Reduce the Foe's Defense.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon rises on top of its foe and drops an apple on their head. The foe proceeds to eat the apple, distracting it from the fight.

moveCollection.Name: Gravity
moveCollection.Effect: Flying and Levitating Pokemon can be hit by Ground Type Moves. Lasts 4 Rounds.
moveCollection.Description: The gravity is intensified, bringing everyone to their knees. Flying pokemon are slammed to the ground.

moveCollection.Name: Growl (Cute)
moveCollection.Effect: Reduce the foe's Strength. Sound Based. Same move as "Growl (Tough)", the user should use the one with highest stat (tough / cute)
moveCollection.Description: The user shows its cute demeanor, making the foe unsure about attacking the user with full force.

moveCollection.Name: Growl (Tough)
moveCollection.Effect: Reduce the foe's Strength. Sound Based. Same move as "Growl (Cute)", the user should use the one with highest stat (tough / cute)
moveCollection.Description: The user exhibits a menacing attitude, making the foe unsure about attacking the user with full force.

moveCollection.Name: Growth
moveCollection.Effect: Increase the User's Strength and Special.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon expands its body. It grows bigger and stronger.

moveCollection.Name: Grudge
moveCollection.Effect: The User Faints. The foe gets its Will depleted and any effects gained from spending them. The Foe must roll Loyalty at the end of every Round to keep battling. Each Round 1 more success is required.
moveCollection.Description: The user leaves an imprinting grudge over the foe, this makes the target unwilling to fight. It may only keep battling if something greater is at risk.

moveCollection.Name: Guard Split
moveCollection.Effect: Average your Defense and Sp. Defense with your target.
moveCollection.Description: The user employs its psychic power to average its resilience with the foe. They both feel like they're equals in terms of toughness.

moveCollection.Name: Guard Swap
moveCollection.Effect: Switch your Defense and Sp. Defense with your foe.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon employs its psychic power to make the opponent feel like its got your fraily and make the user ffeel like it got the target's resilience.

moveCollection.Name: Guillotine
moveCollection.Effect: The target is dealt damage equal to its remaining HP plus 1 Lethal. -5 Accuracy.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon uses the sharpest part of its body to almost snap the neck of its foe. It is a devastating attack. The foe must be lucky to get out of it alive.

moveCollection.Name: Gunk Shot
moveCollection.Effect: Ranged. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Poison the Foe. -2 Accuracy.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon shoots a stream of corrosive sludge made with the most toxic substances it can produce. Just inhaling the scent can make you feel very sick.

moveCollection.Name: Gust
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon flaps its wings to strike the foe with wind.

moveCollection.Name: Gyro Ball
moveCollection.Effect: Add 1 Extra Dice to the Damage pool for every point of Dexterity the Foe has that surpasses the user's. Up to 5 Dice may be added this way.
moveCollection.Description: The user curls up in a ball and spins against the target at a high speed.

moveCollection.Name: Hail
moveCollection.Effect: Hail Weather is activated for the next 4 Rounds.
moveCollection.Description: The user summons a hailstorm that will stay on the battlefield for some time.

moveCollection.Name: Hammer Arm
moveCollection.Effect: After dealing damage, Reduce user's Dexterity. -1 Accuracy.
moveCollection.Description: A mighty arm thrust that leaves the user quite tired.

moveCollection.Name: Harden
moveCollection.Effect: Increase the User's Defense.
moveCollection.Description: The user stiffins its body and prepares for any incoming attack.

moveCollection.Name: Haze
moveCollection.Effect: Remove all Increased or Reduced Attributes and Traits on everyone on the Battlefield.
moveCollection.Description: The user sends out a haze that disturbs all the Pokemon engaged in battle. It may conceal whoever is inside.

moveCollection.Name: Head Charge
moveCollection.Effect: Recoil.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon clashes against the foe using its head aas a boulder.

moveCollection.Name: Head Smash
moveCollection.Effect: Recoil. -2 Accuracy.
moveCollection.Description: The user charges head first to attack the foe, the strike is devastating for both.

moveCollection.Name: Headbutt
moveCollection.Effect: Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch. May call Random Encounters when hitting trees.
moveCollection.Description: The user strikes the foe with its hard head. Perfect for taking down fruits from trees or shake Pokemon out of their nests on treetops.

moveCollection.Name: Heal Bell
moveCollection.Effect: Cure the User and allies suffering from Status Conditions. They don't need to be on the battlefield to get this effect. Sound Based.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon chimes a magical bell. Legend says the soothing sound has healing properties.

moveCollection.Name: Heal Block
moveCollection.Effect: No one can regain any lost HP. Lasts 4 Rounds.
moveCollection.Description: The user forces everyone's wounds to stay open by using its immense psychic power.

moveCollection.Name: Heal Order
moveCollection.Effect: Basic Heal.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon commands its swarm to bring some healing honey.

moveCollection.Name: Heal Pulse
moveCollection.Effect: Basic Heal. If successful spend 1 Will to activate.
moveCollection.Description: The user emits a pulse of energy that heals the wounds of its allies.

moveCollection.Name: Healing Wish
moveCollection.Effect: The User faints. One Ally is completely healed from all damage and status ailments.
moveCollection.Description: The power of ultimate love and sacrifice. The user wishes to completely heal all injuries, diseases, and ailments to save someone's life at the cost of their own health.

moveCollection.Name: Heart Stamp
moveCollection.Effect: Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the foe.
moveCollection.Description: This move controls the emotions of the target, making it feel loved and safe. The user may strike immediately.

moveCollection.Name: Heart Swap
moveCollection.Effect: Switch any Trait Increase/Decrease with the target.
moveCollection.Description: The user and the target swap their feelings of powerr and weakness, insecurity and courage, love and hate. Boosts are also swapped.

moveCollection.Name: Heat Crash
moveCollection.Effect: Add 1 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool for every 50 kgs. of weight above the target's weight. Up to +4 Extra Dice may be added this way.
moveCollection.Description: The user slams the target with a body engulfed in fire.

moveCollection.Name: Heat Wave
moveCollection.Effect: Target all foes in Range. Roll 1 Chance Dice to Burn those affected. -1 Accuracy.
moveCollection.Description: The user breathes a giant wave of incandescent air that might set fire to whatever it touches.

moveCollection.Name: Heavy Slam
moveCollection.Effect: Add 1 Extra Dice for every 50 kgs. of weight above the target's weight, up to +4 Extra Dice.
moveCollection.Description: The user slams the foe usin its whole body weight. Smaller foes will be deeply affected.

moveCollection.Name: Help Another
moveCollection.Effect: Roll your Accuracy as if it was Chance Dice. If Successful, add one die to the Action of an Ally. Up to 6 dice may be added this way.

moveCollection.Name: Helping Hand
moveCollection.Effect: Target Pokemon gets 2 Extra Dice on its next Skill, Accuracy and Damage Rolls. Priority 5.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon assists an ally. Together they are stronger.

moveCollection.Name: Hex
moveCollection.Effect: If the Target is affected by a Status Ailment add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool.
moveCollection.Description: The user casts a terrible hex over the target, the effects will be greater if the target is vulnerable.

moveCollection.Name: Hidden Power
moveCollection.Effect: Storyteller decides power and type
moveCollection.Description: Every Pokemon has an unknown power that can be released with surprising results.

moveCollection.Name: High Horsepower
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon rushes towards its target and tramples it without mercy.

moveCollection.Name: High Jump Kick
moveCollection.Effect: If Accuracy Roll is unsuccessful, deal 5 Dice of Damage to the User. -1 Accuracy.
moveCollection.Description: The user launches itself up and falls down with a brutal kick. It might hurt the user if it doesn't hit the target.

moveCollection.Name: Hone Claws
moveCollection.Effect: Increase the User's Strength and Accuracy.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon sharpens its claws to perform more precise attacks.

moveCollection.Name: Horn Attack
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon attacks the foe with its horns. This strike is very painful.

moveCollection.Name: Horn Drill
moveCollection.Effect: The target is dealt damage equal to its remaining HP plus 1 Lethal. -5 Accuracy.
moveCollection.Description: The user stabs the target with a horn used like a drill. The foe is often left in a critical condition. A move to be wary of.

moveCollection.Name: Horn Leech
moveCollection.Effect: The User restores HP equal to half the damage dealt, rounded down.
moveCollection.Description: The user rams the foe and absorbs some of its vital energy with its horns.

moveCollection.Name: Howl
moveCollection.Effect: Increase the User's Strength.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon lets out an impressive howl, making it appear a lot more menacing.

moveCollection.Name: Hurricane
moveCollection.Effect: Lethal. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Confuse the Foe. If Rain Weather in effect ignore this moves reduced accuracy. -2 Accuracy.
moveCollection.Description: The user attacks by wrapping the opponent in a fierce wind that carries the target up into the sky.

moveCollection.Name: Hydro Cannon
moveCollection.Effect: Must Recharge. -1 Accuracy.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon blasts the foe with a water surge that could bring down a house. The user needs to res afterwards.

moveCollection.Name: Hydro Pump
moveCollection.Effect: -1 Accuracy.
moveCollection.Description: The user builds up pressure inside its body and then releases a tremendous amount of water at the target.

moveCollection.Name: Hyper Beam
moveCollection.Effect: Must Recharge. Lethal. -1 Accuracy.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon casts an incredible beam that leaves a giant trail of destruction behind. The user is left exhausted.

moveCollection.Name: Hyper Fang
moveCollection.Effect: Roll 1 Chance Dice to Flinch.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon bites hard into the foe with its powerful fangs.

moveCollection.Name: Hyper Voice
moveCollection.Effect: Sound Based.
moveCollection.Description: The user emits a horrible echoing sound that could burst the ears.

moveCollection.Name: Hyperspace Fury
moveCollection.Effect: Never Fail. Ignores the effect of any Shield Move the Foe might have used. Reduce the user's Defense.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon opens portals to attack with each one of its arms, bypassing all defenses and making it impossible to escape, however, the user's defense also gets neglected.

moveCollection.Name: Hyperspace Hole
moveCollection.Effect: Ignore Defenses. Never Miss. This Move Bypasses the effects of any Shield Move effect on the foe.
moveCollection.Description: The user knows the laws of physics bind it from being in many places at once and forbid it from occupying the same space as other bodies. It just disregards their authority.

moveCollection.Name: Hypnosis
moveCollection.Effect: Put the target to sleep. Dark-Type Pokemon are affected by this move. -4 Accuracy.
moveCollection.Description: Employ a hypnotic suggestion to make the target feel drowsy and fall into a deep slumber. Works better on a target that is not in danger.

moveCollection.Name: Ice Ball
moveCollection.Effect: Successive Actions. Add 1 Extra Dice to the Damage Roll of the last Ice Ball hit the user performes. If the Pokemon used Defense Curl this Round, add 1 Extra Dice to the Damage Roll of every hit. -1 Accuracy.
moveCollection.Description: The user curls into a snowball, rolling against the foe. The ball grows bigger as it rolls.

moveCollection.Name: Ice Beam
moveCollection.Effect: Roll 1 Chance Dice to Freeze the Foe.
moveCollection.Description: The user shoots a freezing ray that greatly lowers the temperature of anything it hits.

moveCollection.Name: Ice Burn
moveCollection.Effect: Lethal. Ranged. Charge Move. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Burn the Foe. -1 Accuracy.
moveCollection.Description: The user appears to become a block of ice, then it releases itself from the ice with a devastating explosion. The exploding ice shards and fire blow all over the battlefield.

moveCollection.Name: Ice Fang
moveCollection.Effect: Roll 2 Chance Dice to Flinch the foe. Roll 2 Chance Dice to Freeze the foe. -1 Accuracy.
moveCollection.Description: The user bites the foe and releases a gelid breath through its mouth.

moveCollection.Name: Ice Hammer
moveCollection.Effect: Reduce User's Dexterity. -1 Accuracy.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon uses its powerful gelid arms and strikes the foe with a swinging motion.

moveCollection.Name: Ice Punch
moveCollection.Effect: Fist Based. Roll 1 Chance Dice to Freeze the foe.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon delivers a strike covered in ice. The user's hands can freeze anything they touch.

moveCollection.Name: Ice Shard
moveCollection.Effect: Ranged. Priority 1.
moveCollection.Description: The user quickly freezes some bits of ice and throws them at the target.

moveCollection.Name: Icicle Crash
moveCollection.Effect: Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Foe. -1 Accuracy.
moveCollection.Description: The user drops a big icicle over the foe, the impact may leave the opponent dazed.

moveCollection.Name: Icicle Spear
moveCollection.Effect: Ranged. Successive Actions.
moveCollection.Description: The user launches a wave of small but pointy icicles towards the target.

moveCollection.Name: Icy Wind
moveCollection.Effect: Reduce Dexterity of those affected.
moveCollection.Description: A breeze so cold that it chills you to the bone, making it harder to move.

moveCollection.Name: Imprison
moveCollection.Effect: The foe cannot use any Moves known by the User. Lasts for a day.
moveCollection.Description: This move blocks specific parts of the memory the user is well aware of. Be it moves, techniques, names, places, people, or situations. The target won't be able to recall those memories.

moveCollection.Name: Incinerate
moveCollection.Effect: Destroy the held Berries of those affected.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon releases a blast of fire that instantly consumes small flammable objects.

moveCollection.Name: Inferno
moveCollection.Effect: Lethal. Apply Burn 3 to the Foe. -3 Accuracy.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon sets the foe on fire. These flames rise up to 6 feet. A very dangerous Move.

moveCollection.Name: Infestation
moveCollection.Effect: Blocks. Roll 2 Dice of Damage against the foe at the end of each Round. Lasts 4 Rounds.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon summons a huge swarm of bugs to prevent the foe from escaping. Sometimes the swarm may take a hit to the foe. The call extends for hundreds of yards.

moveCollection.Name: Ingrain
moveCollection.Effect: User Heals 1 HP at the end of every Round. While this move is active the User is now Blocked.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon roots itself to the ground, absorbing the nutrients and recovering health.

moveCollection.Name: Instruct
moveCollection.Effect: Selected Target repeats their last move used this Round, taking the successes on the Accuracy Roll of "Instruct" as if they were for their move. Target must have previously used a successful move during the Round. Otherwise "Instruct" will fail.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon sends a psychic command to one of its allies or foes to enable them to repeat their last action.

moveCollection.Name: Ion Deluge
moveCollection.Effect: For the rest of the Scene, Normal Type Moves will deal damage as if they were Electric Type Moves.
moveCollection.Description: The user amplifies all electrically charged particles in the environment. The results are shocking!

moveCollection.Name: Iron Defense
moveCollection.Effect: Increase the User's Defense by 2.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon hardens its body surface as if it was made from the strongest iron around.

moveCollection.Name: Iron Head
moveCollection.Effect: Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Foe.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon charges at the foe with a brutal headbutt that may leave the target knocked down on the ground.

moveCollection.Name: Iron Tail
moveCollection.Effect: Roll 3 Chance Dice to Reduce the foe's Defense. -3 Accuracy.
moveCollection.Description: The user hits the foe with its hardened tail. The target is left vulnerable against subsequent attacks.

moveCollection.Name: Jaw Lock
moveCollection.Effect: Both User and Target are Blocked.
moveCollection.Description: The user will capture its foe in a crushing jaw grip. It won't let go no matter how much you try to seperate them. The only way it will release its victim is by fainting.

moveCollection.Name: Judgment
moveCollection.Effect: Ignore Defenses. This Move is considered to be any Type the user wants. If something would prevent this Move from dealing Damage, ignore it. This Move can't be Clashed. This Move's Power and extra Added Effects are decided by the Storyteller.
moveCollection.Description: Eventually, everyone gets what they deserve.

moveCollection.Name: Jump Kick
moveCollection.Effect: If Accuracy Roll is unsuccessful, deal 4 Dice of Damage to the User.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon jumps and delivers a powerful kick. It might hurt the user if it doesn't hit the target.

moveCollection.Name: Karate Chop
moveCollection.Effect: High Critical.
moveCollection.Description: A basic fighting chop that has been practiced and mastered.

moveCollection.Name: Kinesis
moveCollection.Effect: Lower the foe's Accuracy.
moveCollection.Description: A basic psychic power to exert force on objects. You can touch, move, press, and affect simple objects to create distractions.

moveCollection.Name: King's Shield
moveCollection.Effect: Priority 3. Shield. If the foe was using a Physical Move. Reduce the foe's Strength by 2. Reduce 3 Dice from the foe's Damage Pool.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon uses a ghostly shield to protect itself. If the foe managed to touch it, the user will drain some of its lifeforce.

moveCollection.Name: Knock Off
moveCollection.Effect: The target Pokemon loses its held item.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon makes a quick tackle that knocks off anything the foe was holding.

moveCollection.Name: Land's Wrath
moveCollection.Effect: Lethal. Ranged. All Foes in Range.
moveCollection.Description: The earth moves on its own, no attacker in sight. The floor crumbles and the ground shakes while engulfing its victims. From the rubble, lush trees emerge a short time after.

moveCollection.Name: Laser Focus
moveCollection.Effect: The next time the user lands a hit it will be treated as if it were a Critical Hit.
moveCollection.Description: Through its incredible awareness the Pokemon finds a straight path into a weak point of the foe. The attack that follows is usually devastating.

moveCollection.Name: Last Resort
moveCollection.Effect: It can be used only after the Pokemon has performed all its known moves at least once during the battle.
moveCollection.Description: When everything else fails, the Pokemon gives everything in a last resort attack.

moveCollection.Name: Lava Plume
moveCollection.Effect: Roll 3 Chance Dice to Burn those affected.
moveCollection.Description: The user shoots up bits of molten lava that fall scattered around the field.

moveCollection.Name: Leaf Blade
moveCollection.Effect: Lethal. High Critical.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon uses the sharp leaves on its body to cut through the foe.

moveCollection.Name: Leaf Storm
moveCollection.Effect: Reduce the User's Special by 2. -1 Accuracy.
moveCollection.Description: A furious storm of sharp leaves swirls and pierces the target. The user is left exhausted.

moveCollection.Name: Leaf Tornado
moveCollection.Effect: Roll 5 Chance Dice to Reduce the Foe's Accuracy. -1 Accuracy.
moveCollection.Description: A bush worth of sharp leaves swirls around the foe making it harder for it to aim attacks properly.

moveCollection.Name: Leafage
moveCollection.Effect: Ranged.
moveCollection.Description: The user throws leaf darts towards its foe.

moveCollection.Name: Leech Life
moveCollection.Effect: The user restores HP equal to half the damage dealt rounded down.
moveCollection.Description: The user attacks a vital spot and sucks away the vitality of its foe.

moveCollection.Name: Leech Seed
moveCollection.Effect: If successful spend 1 Will point to activate. At the end of each Round, Roll 1 Dice of Damage to the foe. User heals for 1 HP for every damage dealt this way. Grass Type Pokemon are immune to this Move. -1 Accuracy.
moveCollection.Description: The user plants some seeds on the target, the seeds sprout and restore the user's health by absorbing the foe's vital energy.

moveCollection.Name: Leer
moveCollection.Effect: Reduce the Defense of those affected.
moveCollection.Description: A vicious glare that will make any opponent doubt its own strength in battle.

moveCollection.Name: Lick
moveCollection.Effect: Roll 3 Chance Dice to Paralyze the Foe.
moveCollection.Description: The user licks the foe. The saliva can numb the body of most creatures.

moveCollection.Name: Life Dew
moveCollection.Effect: If successful, spend 1 Will point to activate. User and Allies in Range heal 1 HP at the end of each Round. Lasts 4 Rounds.
moveCollection.Description: The user creates a fresh-water dew that makes it and its allies full of energy.

moveCollection.Name: Light Of Ruin
moveCollection.Effect: Lethal. Recoil. -1 Accuracy.
moveCollection.Description: By drawing energy from the Eternal Flower, the Pokemon unleashes all of its hurt. A beautiful light surrounds the area, yet the pain inside of its heart remains.

moveCollection.Name: Light Screen
moveCollection.Effect: User and Allies will receive 1 less Damage from Special Attacks. Lasts 4 Rounds.
moveCollection.Description: The user manifests its mental power on the world, creating walls and floors of light that help prevent the passing of energies.

moveCollection.Name: Liquidation
moveCollection.Effect: Lethal. Roll 2 Chance Dice to Reduce the Foe's Defense.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon gets close to its foe then strikes while bursting a full-force blast of pressurized water, the water may cut or dent through the foe's armor.

moveCollection.Name: Lock-On
moveCollection.Effect: The next attack the user performs has 2 automatic unremovable successes on its Accuracy Roll.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon's eyes zoom at a moving target to ensure that the next attack will be dealt with precision.

moveCollection.Name: Lovely Kiss
moveCollection.Effect: Put the Target to Sleep.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon approaches the foe with a kiss. Its ugly face and awful smooch make the poor creature faint in terror.

moveCollection.Name: Low Kick
moveCollection.Effect: Add 1 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool for every 50 kgs. of weight on the foe. Up to +4 Extra Dice may be added this way.
moveCollection.Description: The user kicks the target making it fall, the bigger the foe the harder the fall.

moveCollection.Name: Low Sweep
moveCollection.Effect: Reduce Foe's Dexterity by 2.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon strikes the foe's legs, leaving it unable to walk normally or run.

moveCollection.Name: Lucky Chant
moveCollection.Effect: User and Allies in range can re-roll one un-successful die from all their rolls until the end of the scene. If an opponent would land a Critical Hit it doesn't. Outside of battle good things happen at the story tellers discretion.
moveCollection.Description: The user chants an incantation to the skies. The beautiful performance grants this Pokemon and its allies divine protection.

moveCollection.Name: Lunar Dance
moveCollection.Effect: The user Faints. One fallen Ally regains consciousness, has its HP fully restored and all Status Ailments healed. If the Ally was not in-battle, it is called out and ready to fight.
moveCollection.Description: The moon shines at the darkest hours, reflecting the sun's lifebringer light on those who fell into the night, taking pity on their lost souls.

moveCollection.Name: Lunge
moveCollection.Effect: Reduce foe's Strength.
moveCollection.Description: The user charges against the foe at full force, not just to knock it down but to restain it with its many limbs.

moveCollection.Name: Luster Purge
moveCollection.Effect: Roll 5 Chance Dice to Reduce the foe's Sp. Defense. This Effect can be repeated up to 3 times per Target.
moveCollection.Description: The user engulfs itself in a blinding light and shoots a beam at its foe. This light leaves the foe powerless to resist against anyone.

moveCollection.Name: Mach Punch
moveCollection.Effect: Fist Based. Priority 1.
moveCollection.Description: The user launches a punch so quickly that it's barely seen.

moveCollection.Name: Magic Coat
moveCollection.Effect: Priority 4. Redirect the effects of a Support Move that would affect the user or its side of the battlefield towards the foe's (ie. The foe used Stealth Rock, with Magic Coat it will now affect the foe's side instead of yours).
moveCollection.Description: The user quickly creates a barrier that reflects any minor attack, status condition, or dirty triick the foe might have wanted to use.

moveCollection.Name: Magic Powder
moveCollection.Effect: Change the target's Type to Psychic.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon recites an enchantment and blows a cloud of pink dust on its Target. Afterwards, the target becomes especially good at guessing which card you got from a deck.

moveCollection.Name: Magic Room
moveCollection.Effect: No one can use their Held Item nor any other Item. Lasts 4 Rounds.
moveCollection.Description: Inside the effects of Magic Room, technology, tools, and items manually activated do not work. Automated technology will function as normal.

moveCollection.Name: Magical Leaf
moveCollection.Effect: Never Fail.
moveCollection.Description: The user sends out a floating leaf that will pursue the target until it hits.

moveCollection.Name: Magma Storm
moveCollection.Effect: Blocks. Roll 3 Damage Dice at the end of each Round. Lasts 4 Rounds. -2 Accuracy.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon shoots a fiery eruption to its foe. Unable to escape and surrounded by the unbearable heat the foe's survival is at risk.

moveCollection.Name: Magnet Bomb
moveCollection.Effect: Ranged. Never Fail.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon hurls a metal bomb that is attracted to the target like a magnet. The moment it touches the foe, it will explode.

moveCollection.Name: Magnet Rise
moveCollection.Effect: For the Next 4 Rounds the User gains immunity against Ground Type Moves.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon uses the magnetic field of the earth to repel itself from the ground, allowing it to float for a short period of time.

moveCollection.Name: Magnetic Flux
moveCollection.Effect: Increase the Defense and Sp. Defense of User and all its Electric and Steel Type Allies.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon bends the magnetic field around itself, this also affects all allies who are sensible to it.

moveCollection.Name: Magnitude
moveCollection.Effect: Ranged. 1 Dice to determine this Move's Power
moveCollection.Description: The user quakes the ground plates. Some plates will move easier than others.

moveCollection.Name: Mat Block
moveCollection.Effect: Shield. Reduce 3 Dice from the foe's Damage Pool. This Move only works the first Round the User has been out.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon uses a mat or something similar as a shield.

moveCollection.Name: Me First
moveCollection.Effect: Priority 1. The User copies and uses the Move the target was intending to use. It must be a damaging Move.
moveCollection.Description: The user anticipates the next attack so it can hit the target with an astounding speed.

moveCollection.Name: Mean Look
moveCollection.Effect: Blocks.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon gives a menacing look that freezes the foe on the spot with intense fear.

moveCollection.Name: Meditate
moveCollection.Effect: Increase the User's Strength
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon meditates to unleash a power that's been sleeping deep inside the user.

moveCollection.Name: Mega Drain
moveCollection.Effect: The user restores HP equal to half the damage dealt, rounded down.
moveCollection.Description: The user absorbs a big amount of vital energy from the target.

moveCollection.Name: Mega Kick
moveCollection.Effect: -2 Accuracy.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon throws a mega powered kick to the foe's face.

moveCollection.Name: Mega Punch
moveCollection.Effect: -1 Accuracy.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon throws a mega potent hook towards the foe's face.

moveCollection.Name: Megahorn
moveCollection.Effect: Lethal Damage. -2 Accuracy.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon uses its strong horn(s) to pierce its foe and deal massive damage.

moveCollection.Name: Memento
moveCollection.Effect: The user faints. Reduce foe's Strength. Dexterity. Special. Defense and Sp. Defense by 2. Lasts for a whole scene.
moveCollection.Description: The user unleashes all its remaining power to send a wave of hopeless thoughts to haunt the foe's mind and soul. The target will be left in grief.

moveCollection.Name: Metal Burst
moveCollection.Effect: This Move only works if the foe just used an attack. Roll the same Damage Pool as your foe's last attack and add 2 Extra Damage Dice.
moveCollection.Description: After receiving damage, the user bursts the tiny but sharp metal piece that came loose because of the foe's attack. The greater the impact the more metal it will shoot.

moveCollection.Name: Metal Claw
moveCollection.Effect: Roll 1 Chance Dice to Increase the user's Strength. -1 Accuracy.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon attacks using its sharp claws, the friction may leave them even sharper.

moveCollection.Name: Metal Sound
moveCollection.Effect: Sound Based. Reduce the foe's Special Defense by 2.
moveCollection.Description: The user produces a horrible noise that impedes the foe from focusing on the fight, leaving it vulnerable to attacks.

moveCollection.Name: Meteor Assault
moveCollection.Effect: Lethal. Must Recharge. -1 Accuracy.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon will make an incredible jump to the sky, then lunge towards the foe at a staggering speed, crashing the ground upon impact. The user is left very tired.

moveCollection.Name: Meteor Mash
moveCollection.Effect: Fist Based. Roll 2 Chance Dice to Increase the User's Strength. -1 Accuracy.
moveCollection.Description: The user charges with a strong fist and strikes like a meteor.

moveCollection.Name: Metronome

moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon waves its hands with rhythm. The energy around follows the cadence and manifests with an impressive attack.

moveCollection.Name: Milk Drink

moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon drinks a glass of its own milk. The rich taste and nutrients revitalize it.

moveCollection.Description: Making use of its acting talents, the Pokemon imitates what the target just did.

moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon has had a terrible day and has a very bad headache, try not to disturb its peace because its head feels like exploding.

moveCollection.Name: Mind Reader

moveCollection.Description: The user reads the foe's mind. It knows exactly what to do next.

moveCollection.Name: Minimize

moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon compacts its body, appearing smaller than its normal size.

moveCollection.Name: Miracle Eye
