moveCollection.Description: The user's sight transcends the flesh and can look directly into the innermost mental pressence of everyone around. Hidden enemies can be detected.

moveCollection.Name: Mirror Coat
moveCollection.Effect: The move only works if the foe just used a Special Attack. Roll the same Damage Pool as your foe's last attack and add 2 Extra Damage Dice. Ignore the foe's Defenses.
moveCollection.Description: The user canalizes the damage received by energies and bounces them back to their source.

moveCollection.Name: Mirror Move
moveCollection.Effect: Copies the last Damaging Move the foe has performed.
moveCollection.Description: The user concentrates and manages to imitate the last move used by the foe.

moveCollection.Name: Mirror Shot
moveCollection.Effect: Roll 3 Chance Dice to Confuse the foe. -2 Accuracy.
moveCollection.Description: The user dazes the foe with a beam of light. Those who have experienced it describe it as

moveCollection.Name: Mist Ball
moveCollection.Effect: Roll 5 Chance Dice to Reduce the foe's Special. This Effect can be repeated up to 3 times per Target.
moveCollection.Description: The user engulfs its foe with a cloud of mist. This soothing mist keeps evil intents from surfacing into the foe's mind.

moveCollection.Name: Mist
moveCollection.Effect: For the next 4 Rounds, the User and Allies cannot have their Attributes or Traits reduced.
moveCollection.Description: The user cloaks itself and its allies within cold mist with mystic properties, it may conceal whoever is nearby.

moveCollection.Name: Misty Terrain
moveCollection.Effect: Creatures standing on the battlefield won't be affected by Status Ailments. Dragon Type attacks won't add their Power to the Damage Pool. Lasts 4 Rounds.
moveCollection.Description: The user surrounds the battlefield with a mystical mist that feels protective. Mythical Pokemon find something eerie about it.

moveCollection.Name: Moonblast
moveCollection.Effect: Roll 3 Chance Dice to Reduce foe's Special.
moveCollection.Description: Summon power directly from the moon. The Pokemon blasts the foe with light.

moveCollection.Name: Moongeist Beam
moveCollection.Effect: Lethal. If anything on the foe's side would prevent this move from dealing damage (Pokemon Type, Abilities, Shield Moves, Weather or Barriers) ignore it. This Move cannot be Clashed.
moveCollection.Description: A cold reflection of the moon shines upon the target, it doesn't hurt physically but those who stare directly into the light simply collapse.

moveCollection.Name: Moonlight
moveCollection.Effect: Basic Heal. If successful spend 1 Will point to activate. If performed at Night or Sunny Weather is in effect this move becomes a Complete Heal. If Rain/Sandstorm Weather is in effect this move only heals 1 HP
moveCollection.Description: The user gathers power from the light of the moon, the energy absorbed can heal most injuries.

moveCollection.Name: Morning Sun
moveCollection.Effect: Basic Heal. If successful spend 1 Will point to activate. Complete Heal during Sunny Weather. If Rain/Sandstorm Weather is in effect or it's night or you are indoors/underground this move only heals 1 HP.
moveCollection.Description: The sun shines brightly on the Pokemon and makes it feel rejuvenated like early in the morning.

moveCollection.Name: Mud Bomb
moveCollection.Effect: Roll 3 Chance Dice to Reduce the Foe's Accuracy. -2 Accuracy.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon shoots a ball made of mud that bursts on the target, some mud may get on its eyes.

moveCollection.Name: Mud Shot
moveCollection.Effect: Reduce the Foe's Dexterity.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon shoots a stream of mud that covers the foe, obstructing its movement.

moveCollection.Name: Mud Slap
moveCollection.Effect: Reduce the foe's Accuracy.
moveCollection.Description: The user hurls some mud to the face of the foe, leaving it unable to see clearly.

moveCollection.Name: Mud Sport
moveCollection.Effect: For the next 4 Rounds Electric Type attacks won't add their Power to the Damage Pool.
moveCollection.Description: The user covers everything with mud, reducing the effectiveness of electric attacks made on the field.

moveCollection.Name: Muddy Water
moveCollection.Effect: All Foes in Range. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Reduce the Accuracy of those affected. -2 Accuracy.
moveCollection.Description: The user fills its mouth with dirt and spits a torrent of mud at the foes. This mud may get in the eyes of the enemies.

moveCollection.Name: Multi-Attack
moveCollection.Effect: This Move's type will always match the User's first Type.
moveCollection.Description: A weird-looking Pokemon charged against its foes, the same attack releases different kinds of energy depending on the disk it was holding.

moveCollection.Name: Mystical Fire
moveCollection.Effect: Reduce Foe's Special.
moveCollection.Description: This mystical fire not only burns the foe, it also drains its power.

moveCollection.Name: Nasty Plot
moveCollection.Effect: Increase the user's Special by 2.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon starts plotting on how to defeat the enemy. Its evil laugh reveals the bad intentions.

moveCollection.Name: Natural Gift
moveCollection.Effect: User loses its held berry. Ranged. See Natural Gift on p.432 for more info.
moveCollection.Description: The user throws its berry at the foe. The results can be quite surprising.

moveCollection.Name: Nature Power
moveCollection.Effect: The type of this move is determined by the environment. See Nature Power p.432 for more info.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon makes use of the terrain and asks the nature for aid in battle.

moveCollection.Name: Nature's Madness
moveCollection.Effect: Damage Roll is Half of the Foe's remaining HP (up to 10) Rounded down. If the remaining HP of the foe is 1, this move fails. Ignore the foe's Defenses. -1 Accuracy.
moveCollection.Description: The forces of nature attack as if they had a will of their own. Water will try to drown you, plants will trap you, lightning will come out of nowhere, and even your own body will fail you.

moveCollection.Name: Needle Arm
moveCollection.Effect: Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Foe.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon hits the foe with its flailing arms, some thorns may get stuck on the target like needles.

moveCollection.Name: Night Daze
moveCollection.Effect: Roll 4 Chance Dice to Reduce foe's Accuracy.
moveCollection.Description: The user forms a pitch black wave that hurts the foe. This darkness may remain obstructing the target's vision.

moveCollection.Name: Night Shade

moveCollection.Description: The user casts a shade with a frightening mirage inside that torments the target.

moveCollection.Name: Night Slash
moveCollection.Effect: Lethal. High Critical.
moveCollection.Description: The user quickly slashes through the target as soon as it gets the chance. The intent to end the target's life is frightening.

moveCollection.Name: Nightmare
moveCollection.Effect: Will only work if the Target is asleep. Deal 1 Damage to the foe. Deal 1 Damage again at the beginning of each Round if the target is still asleep.
moveCollection.Description: The user enters the target's dream to torment it.

moveCollection.Name: No Retreat
moveCollection.Effect: Increase the User's Strength, Dexterity, Special, Defense and Sp. Defense. The user is now blocked.
moveCollection.Description: No surrender. No retreat. Until victory always.

moveCollection.Name: Noble Roar
moveCollection.Effect: Reduce the foe's Strength and Special.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon makes a roar that commands respect and authority over anyone listening.

moveCollection.Name: Nuzzle
moveCollection.Effect: Paralyze the foe.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon rubs its electrified cheeks against the foe, it looks very cute but it can be dangerous.

moveCollection.Name: Oblivion Wing
moveCollection.Effect: Lethal. High Critical.
moveCollection.Description: A dark wind rises, turning everything it touches into dust to be scattered until nothing remains. People, Pokemon, plants, everything fades until a distant memory.

moveCollection.Name: Obstruct
moveCollection.Effect: Priority 4. Shield Move. * If the Foe used a Non-Ranged Physical Move against the user, Reduce the Foes Defense by 2. Reduce 3 Dice from the foe's Damage Pool.
moveCollection.Description: In a reckless action, the user charges against the foe to stop its momentum and block its incoming attack. Being so close allows the user to reach for weak spots.

moveCollection.Name: Octazooka
moveCollection.Effect: Roll 5 Chance Dice to Reduce the foe's Accuracy. -2 Accuracy.
moveCollection.Description: The user sprays ink at the target's face to obstruct its vison.

moveCollection.Name: Octolock
moveCollection.Effect: Block. Reduce the foe's Defense and Sp. Defense.
moveCollection.Description: The user wraps its tentacles to immobilize the foe. Being so close enables the user to find weak spots.

moveCollection.Name: Odor Sleuth
moveCollection.Effect: The Foe can not Evade moves performed by the User. User's Normal and Fighting Moves can affect Ghost Types and Ghost Moves can affect Normal Types. Add all Successes from this Move to any Rolls to Track the target.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon uses its keen smell to detect the foe.

moveCollection.Name: Ominous Wind
moveCollection.Effect: Roll 1 Chance Dice to Increase the User's Strength, Dexterity, Special, Defense, and Sp. Defense.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon sends out a goosebump-inducing, repulsive wind that might make the user feel an evil rush.

moveCollection.Name: Origin Pulse
moveCollection.Effect: Lethal. -2 Accuracy.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon sends a giant pulse underwater that creates a chain reaction and causes water to move in large streams. It is believed that all water in the sea moves thanks to this.

moveCollection.Name: Outrage
moveCollection.Effect: Rampage.
moveCollection.Description: The user awakens their primal instinct as a dragon and unleashes its uncontrollable fury, destroying everything in its path. After that, the Pokemon is left disoriented and confused.

moveCollection.Name: Overdrive
moveCollection.Effect: All Foes in Range. Sound Based.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon uses its own body as an amplifier for the energizing sounds it produces.

moveCollection.Name: Overheat
moveCollection.Effect: Lethal. Reduce User's Special by 2. -1 Accuracy.
moveCollection.Description: A furious wave of scorching fire that will turn to ashes everything it touches, exhausting the user afterwards.

moveCollection.Name: Pain Split

moveCollection.Description: The user shares its pain with the foe. After a short while it becomes excruciating for the target.

moveCollection.Name: Parabolic Charge
moveCollection.Effect: The user restores HP equal to half the damage dealt to one target, rounded down.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon lets go of a big electric charge from its body. The charge comes back to it even bigger.

moveCollection.Name: Parting Shot
moveCollection.Effect: Reduce foe's Strength and Special. The user switches out, the new Pokemon arrives ready to fight. Roll for its initiative. Switcher Move.
moveCollection.Description: The user threatens the foe, leaving it too scared to pursuit the user or overwhelm the ally that just switched in the battlefield.

moveCollection.Name: Pay Day
moveCollection.Effect: Ranged. At the end of the battle give Money to the Trainer Equal to its Rank: Starter/Beginner - $20.00 Amateur - $50.00 Ace - $75.00 Pro - $100.00
moveCollection.Description: This move grants good fortune, making it more likely to get more money after each battle.

moveCollection.Name: Payback
moveCollection.Effect: Add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool if the target already damaged you this Round.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon tackles the target with hatred and vengeance.

moveCollection.Name: Peck
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon uses its beak or horn to jab the foe, hurting a little bit.

moveCollection.Name: Perish Song
moveCollection.Effect: After three rounds, if any Pokemon who heard the song is not removed from battle, it will receive its remaining HP as damage. Sound Based.
moveCollection.Description: A song of mourning and despair that resonates on the minds of anyone who listens. Makes you feel like you are on your death bed.

moveCollection.Name: Petal Blizzard
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon showers the battlefield with a raging blizzard of petals and leaves, anyone close to the user will suffer the consequences.

moveCollection.Name: Petal Dance
moveCollection.Effect: Rampage.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon starts swirling petals around in a true display of nature's power, the petals are guided by the wind to strike the foe.

moveCollection.Name: Phantom Force
moveCollection.Effect: Charge Move. While charging this Move, other Moves will not affect the user. If the Target made a Shielding Action the shield is destroyed and won't have any effect.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon disappears into a dark dimension to infiltrate even the most impenetrable defenses. It may reappear during its next action.

moveCollection.Name: Photon Geyser (Physical)
moveCollection.Effect: This Move's Damage Pool, can be rolled with either the Strength or Special Attribute, dealing Physical or Special Damage respectively. Choose whatever is most convenient for the user.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon attacks with a large pillar of light that comes out from where its foe is standing, either the blazing energy  or the crushing strikes are enough to knock someone out.

moveCollection.Name: Photon Geyser (Special)

moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon attacks with a large pillar of light that comes out from where its foe is standing, either the blazing energy  or the crushing strikes are enough to knock someone out.

moveCollection.Name: Pika Papow

moveCollection.Description: The User lets out its energy in the form of a lightning strike, the happier the user feels the more energized it will be.

moveCollection.Name: Pin Missile
moveCollection.Effect: Ranged. Successive Actions.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon showers its foe with stings or spikes that pierce like needles.

moveCollection.Name: Plasma Fists

moveCollection.Name: Play Nice

moveCollection.Name: Play Rough
moveCollection.Effect: Roll 1 Chance Dice to Reduce foe's Strength. -1 Accuracy.
moveCollection.Description: The user and the foe start a playful wrestle, it soon escalates into something not so pretty.

moveCollection.Name: Pluck

moveCollection.Description: The user gives a hard peck and may get something tasty out of the foe.

moveCollection.Name: Poison Fang
moveCollection.Effect: Roll 5 Chance Dice to Badly Poison the Foe.

moveCollection.Name: Poison Gas
moveCollection.Effect: Poison those affected. -1 Accuracy.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon releases a big cloud of toxic gas, anyone who takes a breath will start coughing violently. They should seek a doctor immediately.

moveCollection.Name: Poison Jab
moveCollection.Effect: Roll 3 Chance Dice to Poison the Foe.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon stabs its foe with a sting or tentacle drenched with venom.

moveCollection.Name: Poison Powder
moveCollection.Effect: Poison the Foe. -2 Accuracy.
moveCollection.Description: The user scatters a small cloud of venomous dust that immediately causes coughing and fever.

moveCollection.Name: Poison Sting
moveCollection.Effect: Ranged. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Poison the Target.
moveCollection.Description: The user shoots a small sting that injects venom into the foe.

moveCollection.Name: Poison Tail
moveCollection.Effect: High Critical. Roll 1 Chance Dice to Poison the Foe.

moveCollection.Name: Pollen Puff

moveCollection.Name: Poltergeist
moveCollection.Effect: Can only be used if the Target is Holding an Item or if Items have been used on the Target's side of the field.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon's spirit possesses an Item and attacks with that cursed object. It is said that if the Pokemon lingers too long possessing an object, it'll have trouble getting out.

moveCollection.Name: Pound
moveCollection.Description: A decent hit to smash the foes.

moveCollection.Name: Powder Snow
moveCollection.Effect: Roll 1 Chance Dice to Freeze those affected.
moveCollection.Description: The user sends out a wind current full of snowflakes that freeze whatever they touch. This powder can easily turn a room to ice.

moveCollection.Name: Powder
moveCollection.Effect: Add 3 Dice of Damage to the next Fire Type attack that hits the target.
moveCollection.Description: The foe is fully covered with a flammable powder, a source of fire might ignite it with explosive results.

moveCollection.Name: Power Gem
moveCollection.Description: The user attacks with a ray of light that comes out of the gem on its body.

moveCollection.Name: Power Split
moveCollection.Effect: Average the User's Strength and Special with the target.

moveCollection.Name: Power Swap
moveCollection.Effect: Switch your Strength and Special with your foe.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon employs its psychic power to make the opponent feel like it's got your weaknesses and make the user feel like it's got the target's strength.

moveCollection.Name: Power Trick

moveCollection.Description: The user's mind is tricked into thinking that strength comes from their vitality, and their vitality is their power.

moveCollection.Name: Power Whip
moveCollection.Effect: -2 Accuracy.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon violently lashes the foe with its vines or a part of its body, acting as a powerful whip.

moveCollection.Name: Power-Up Punch

moveCollection.Name: Precipice Blades
moveCollection.Effect: Lethal. Ranged. -2 Accuracy.

moveCollection.Name: Present

moveCollection.Name: Prismatic Laser

moveCollection.Description: The user creates an energy shield to deflect a blow. Some Pokemon may even perform an amazing parry to block the incoming attack.

moveCollection.Name: Psybeam
moveCollection.Effect: Roll 1 Chance Dice to Confuse the foe.

moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon mentalizes itself stronger than anyone. They feel good. They can win. They. Can. Do. This.

moveCollection.Name: Psychic
moveCollection.Effect: Roll 1 Chance Dice to Reduce the foe's Sp. Defense.

moveCollection.Name: Psycho Boost
moveCollection.Effect: Lethal. Reduce User's Special by 2. -1 Accuracy.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon releases an explosion of all of its concentrated psychic power in a devastating explosion, afterwards the user will be extremely tired.

moveCollection.Name: Psycho Cut
moveCollection.Effect: High Critical.
moveCollection.Description: Create blades of psychic energy to tear down foes.

moveCollection.Name: Psycho Shift
moveCollection.Effect: Transfer the User's Status Ailments to the target. The user is now cured.

moveCollection.Description: Releases the inner power of the mind to emanate psychic waves that hurt the target.

moveCollection.Name: Punishment

moveCollection.Description: The user takes advantage of its foe's strengths to use them against it.

moveCollection.Name: Purify
moveCollection.Effect: Heal a Target's Status Ailment. If you do then the user may heal 1 HP.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon is covered by a gelatinous goo that can be used to treat several ailments, the Pokemon also uses it as a source of nourishment.

moveCollection.Name: Pursuit

moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon chases the foe to deliver a final blow before it escapes.

moveCollection.Name: Pyro Ball

moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon lights a heavy stone on fire and kicks it while it's ablaze. The hit is pretty heavy already, the fire is just for showing off.

moveCollection.Name: Quash

moveCollection.Description: The user represses the foe with intimidation so it has to think twice before acting.

moveCollection.Name: Quick Attack

moveCollection.Description: An attack as fast as lightning.

moveCollection.Description: The user reacts instinctively and defends itself and its teammates, nullifying the effects of the fastest attacks.

moveCollection.Name: Quiver Dance

moveCollection.Name: Rain Dance
moveCollection.Effect: Rain Weather is activated for the next 4 Rounds.
moveCollection.Description: The user performs a curious mystic dance that summons a heavy rainfall.

moveCollection.Name: Rapid Spin

moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon spins swiftly to strike the foe. Anything near will be scattered around.

moveCollection.Name: Razor Leaf
moveCollection.Effect: Ranged. High Critical.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon shoots one or more sharp leaves that cut through all targets as if they were razors.

moveCollection.Name: Razor Shell
moveCollection.Effect: Roll 1 Chance Dice to Reduce the foe's Defense.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon uses its sharp shell as a weapon to cut the target's fur, armor or anything protecting its body.

moveCollection.Name: Razor Wind
moveCollection.Effect: High Critical. Charge.
moveCollection.Description: A sharp wind current is unleased against anyone standing against this Pokemon.

moveCollection.Name: Recover

moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon concentrates on restoring its own cells faster than anything imaginable.

moveCollection.Name: Recycle

moveCollection.Description: One Pokemon's trash is another one's treasure.

moveCollection.Name: Reflect

moveCollection.Description: The user manifests its mental power on the world, creating invisible walls and floors that prevent the passing of objects.

moveCollection.Name: Refresh

moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon takes a few seconds to cool down and get back in the game.

moveCollection.Name: Relic Song

moveCollection.Description: The user sings and dances to a melody so beautiful you won't notice you were crying while listening to it.

moveCollection.Name: Rest

moveCollection.Description: The user falls asleep. During this period the body benefits from a super accelerated healing process.

moveCollection.Name: Retaliate
moveCollection.Effect: If an ally fainted during this or the last Round, add 3 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool. This effect can only be used once per Ally.
moveCollection.Description: A powerful attack. It will be even stronger if the user just suffered a great loss.

moveCollection.Name: Return
moveCollection.Effect: Add 1 Dice to the Damage Roll for every point of Happiness on the User.
moveCollection.Description: If the Pokemon is treated with care and love, it will return that affection by giving all it's got in battle.

moveCollection.Name: Revelation Dance

moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon performa a dance. The dance's energy influences the Type of this Move.

moveCollection.Name: Revenge

moveCollection.Name: Rock Throw

moveCollection.Description: The user mimics the target and takes on the most basic features from that character.

moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon uses its action to land on the ground and relax.

moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon digs around and moves the soil to make it ideal for plant growth.

moveCollection.Name: Sacred Sword
moveCollection.Effect: Ignore any Increases to the foe's Defense.
moveCollection.Description: The user slashes its target with a mighty blade that no armor can stop.

moveCollection.Name: Sand Attack
moveCollection.Effect: Reduce the foe's Accuracy.
moveCollection.Description: The user shoots some sand into the opponent's eyes.

moveCollection.Effect: Sandstorm Weather is activated for the next 4 Rounds.

moveCollection.Description: From a magical bean, the user grows a cute stalk that will attach itself to the nearest target. Once it ingrains, it will grow and grow and grow until it reaches the sky.

moveCollection.Effect: Roll 3 Chance Dice to Burn the foe.
moveCollection.Description: The user shoots a torrent of boiling water, it may leave the foe sopping with burns.

moveCollection.Name: Scary Face

moveCollection.Name: Seed Bomb

moveCollection.Description: The user throws a big seed that explodes on contact with the foe.

moveCollection.Description: The target gets launched up then falls face first into the ground, the stronger the user the higher the foe will be thrown.

moveCollection.Name: Shadow Ball

moveCollection.Description: Claws become semi-ethereal and are able to briefly pierce armor, hide, skin, and objects so it can strike the target on any weak spot.

moveCollection.Name: Shadow Force

moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon will raise the temperature along with the sun, it doesn't work at night, indoors, underground, or underwater.

moveCollection.Name: Sunsteel Strike
moveCollection.Effect: Lethal. If anything on the foe's side of the field would prevent this move from dealing damage (Pokemon types. Abilities. Shield Moves. Weather. Or Barriers.) ignore it. This Move cannot be Clashed.
moveCollection.Description: You suddenly stop your in tracks as you see a bright and blinding light coming towards you at great speed. You did not see what hit you and then it's all darkness.

moveCollection.Name: Super Fang
moveCollection.Effect: Damage Roll is Half of the Foe's remaining HP (up to 10) rounded down. If the remaining HP of the foe is 1 this move fails. Ignore the foe's Defenses. -1 Accuracy.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon jumps at the foe to crush it with an awful bite.

moveCollection.Name: Superpower
moveCollection.Effect: Lethal. Reduce User's Strength and Defense.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon makes use of all its force to deliver a crushing strike to the foe, this demands a lot from the user.

moveCollection.Name: Supersonic
moveCollection.Effect: Confuse the foe. -3 Accuracy.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon emits a series of ultrasonic waves that make the foe dizzy and disoriented.

moveCollection.Name: Surf
moveCollection.Description: A giant wave of water sweeps the area while the user swims on top of it.

moveCollection.Name: Swagger
moveCollection.Effect: Increase the foe's Strength by 2. Inflicts Confusion.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon enrages the foe with its arrogant demeanor, making it lose focus in battle.

moveCollection.Name: Swallow
moveCollection.Effect: Must have used the move "Stockpile" prior to this Move, otherwise it will fail. If successful spend 1 Will point to activate. User restores 2 Health points. Loses the effects of stockpile. The Pokemon must rest an hour before using Swallow again.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon swallows the energy she was storing to restore some damage, it recovers its normal size afterwards.

moveCollection.Name: Sweet Kiss
moveCollection.Effect: Confuse the foe. -2 Accuracy.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon moves towards the foe and plants a delicate kiss on its cheek, then leaves playfully. The foe struggles to know what it meant.

moveCollection.Name: Sweet Scent
moveCollection.Effect: Those affected cannot evade moves performed by the user. Attracts wild Pokemon if used outside of battle.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon releases an aroma that its enemies will love.

moveCollection.Name: Swift
moveCollection.Effect: Never Fail.
moveCollection.Description: The user shoots a star shaped light beam that hits the target at blinding speed.

moveCollection.Name: Switcheroo
moveCollection.Effect: User and Foe switch their Held Item. If only one Pokemon is holding an item it gives it away.
moveCollection.Description: The user quickly switches the held items before the foe can realize what happened.

moveCollection.Name: Swords Dance
moveCollection.Effect: Increase the User's Strength by 2.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon makes a dance that raises its battle spirit.

moveCollection.Name: Synchronoise
moveCollection.Effect: Sound Based. Choose a Type (Fire, Poison, Steel, etc.) this move only affects those with that Type.
moveCollection.Description: The user vibrates with any particular energy Type he chooses. All nearby creatures and objects of that Type are hurt.

moveCollection.Name: Synthesis
moveCollection.Effect: Basic Heal. If Successful spend 1 Will point to activate. If performed under Sunny weather this Move is a Complete Heal. If Rain/Sandstorm Weather is in effect this move only heals 1 HP.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon uses the sunlight as energy to regain its vitality.

moveCollection.Name: Tackle
moveCollection.Description: A basic attack that consists of charging at an enemy.

moveCollection.Name: Tail Glow
moveCollection.Effect: Increase the User's Special by 3.
moveCollection.Description: The user emits a strong light. This Pokemon will stare at its brightness to enter a trance.

moveCollection.Name: Tail Slap
moveCollection.Effect: Successive Actions. -1 Accuracy.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon slaps the foe's face with its strong tail.

moveCollection.Name: Tail Whip
moveCollection.Effect: Reduce the foe's Defense.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon moves its tail in such a cute way that the foe will easily let its guard down.

moveCollection.Name: Tailwind
moveCollection.Effect: For the Next 4 Rounds, Increase the Dexterity of the User and All Allies in the field by 2.
moveCollection.Description: User flaps its wings and casts a turbulent wind that helps the team move significantly faster.

moveCollection.Name: Take Down
moveCollection.Effect: Recoil. -2 Accuracy.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon recklessly grapples the foe to smash it on the ground.

moveCollection.Name: Tar Shot
moveCollection.Effect: Reduce the foe's Dexterity. Until the end of the Scene Fire Type Moves will deal Super-Effective damage against the foe.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon gushes a blob of black tar over its foe. The unfortunate voctim can barely move afterwards, keep it away from fire sources, tar is extrmely flammable.

moveCollection.Name: Taunt
moveCollection.Effect: The target Pokemon can only perform Damaging Moves and Evasion actions for the next 4 Rounds.
moveCollection.Description: The user mocks and teases the target to make it attack in a raging fury.

moveCollection.Name: Tearful Look
moveCollection.Effect: Reduce Foe's Strength and Special.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon's eyes start watering as if it were about to cry, it's foe is moved by the tears and loses its will to fight.

moveCollection.Name: Teatime
moveCollection.Effect: Those affected eat their held berries without gaining their effects. Outside of battle will diffuse violent intentions for a few minutes
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon gathers everyone for a cup of delicious tea. Not eating a snack along with it would be a waste.

moveCollection.Name: Techno Blast
moveCollection.Effect: Lethal. If Genesect is performing this Move, this Move's type may change to: Fire, Ice, Water, or Electric depending on the Driver it has as Held Item.
moveCollection.Description: A laser briefly beams away from the Pokemon, whatever it hits explodes a second later. This move can be modified with the right programming of a computer.

moveCollection.Name: Teeter Dance
moveCollection.Effect: Inflicts Confusion.
moveCollection.Description: The user starts dancing around with wobbly movements. Friends and foes will get dizzy by trying to follow it.

moveCollection.Name: Telekinesis
moveCollection.Effect: All attacks against the target have "Never Fail". The target is immune to Ground Moves. Lasts 2 Rounds.
moveCollection.Description: The user can manipulate objects and creatures with his mind. Pokemon and humans become easier to hit because their movements are restrained.

moveCollection.Name: Teleport
moveCollection.Effect: In the wild, the battle ends. In official battles, it counts as the Pokemon being recalled. Teleportation distances depend on Special and Storyteller's discretion.
moveCollection.Description: Teleport the user and one more creature to a place of tranquility and high psychic resonance such as Pokemon Centers. Ceilings and walls block this move from working.

moveCollection.Name: Thief
moveCollection.Effect: The user steals the foe's Held Item.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon strikes its foe and takes the opportunity to steal whatever the target was holding.

moveCollection.Name: Thousand Arrows
moveCollection.Effect: Lethal. Ranged. All Foes in Range. If successful, Flying and Levitating Pokemon can be hit by Ground-Type Moves for the rest of the scene.
moveCollection.Description: Out of nowhere, pointy shards come raining from the sky towards the foes, even flying creatures will fall to the ground if they are knocked by them. Take cover, this is gonna hurt.

moveCollection.Name: Thousand Waves
moveCollection.Effect: Blocks. Ranged. All Foes in Range.
moveCollection.Description: Solid ground becomes a sandtrap, cracked earth will close to ensnare your feet. It's as it the land itself wanted to trap you. There is no attacker nor escape in sight.

moveCollection.Name: Thrash
moveCollection.Effect: Rampage.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon rampages and starts to attack and destroy everything on its path.

moveCollection.Name: Throat Chop
moveCollection.Effect: The target cannot use any "Sound Based" Move for the rest of the scene.
moveCollection.Description: A heinous attack to a Pokemon's throat that will leave them unable to make a sound for hours.

moveCollection.Name: Thunder Fang
moveCollection.Effect: Roll 2 Chance Dice to Flinch the foe. Roll 2 Chance Dice to Paralyze the foe.
moveCollection.Description: The user lands an electrified bite on the foe. The direct current may affect the foe greatly.

moveCollection.Name: Thunder Punch
moveCollection.Effect: Fist Based. Roll 1 Chance Dice to Paralyze foe.
moveCollection.Description: An Electrified punch to deal a shocking blow.

moveCollection.Name: Thunder Shock
moveCollection.Effect: Roll 1 Chance Dice to Paralyze the foe.
moveCollection.Description: A small electric attack that shocks the foe and may leave it with muscular cramps. Some electric devices hit by this attack will malfunction.

moveCollection.Name: Thunder Wave
moveCollection.Effect: Paralyze the foe. -1 Accuracy.
moveCollection.Description: A tide of bright lightning streams from the floor onto the foe. The target's body will be cramped for hours.

moveCollection.Name: Thunder
moveCollection.Effect: Lethal. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Paralyze foe. If performed under Sunny Weather, Accuracy becomes -3 instead. If performed under Rain Weather, Ignore this Moves Reduced Accuracy. -2 Accuracy.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon commands a tremendous lightning to strike a specific point on the ground. It's quite dangerous.

moveCollection.Name: Thunderbolt
moveCollection.Effect: Roll 1 Chance Dice to Paralyze the foe.
moveCollection.Description: A strong electric attack that shocks and harms the foe. It can destroy most kinds of electric equipment.

moveCollection.Name: Tickle
moveCollection.Effect: Reduce the foe's Strength and Defense.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon tickles the foe. The laughter really disturbs the foe's fighting stance.

moveCollection.Name: Topsy-Turvy
moveCollection.Effect: Any Decreases on the foe's Attributes become Increases and vice versa.
moveCollection.Description: The user changes the nature of its target, bad things become good and good things become bad.

moveCollection.Name: Torment
moveCollection.Effect: The target cannot use the same Moves it used during the last Round. Lasts 4 Rounds.
moveCollection.Description: The user torments and enrages the foe, making it unable to keep using its strategy.

moveCollection.Name: Toxic Spikes
moveCollection.Effect: Foe Pokemon that enter the battlefield become Poisoned. Roll 1 Chance Dice for the Poison to become Badly Poisoned instead. Entry Hazard.
moveCollection.Description: The user lays a trap of scattered poison spikes that attach to the opponent's feet leaving them with a bad case of fever.

moveCollection.Name: Toxic Thread
moveCollection.Effect: Reduce Foe's Dexterity. Poison the Foe.
moveCollection.Description: The user shoots a sticky thread that entangles around the foe, the thread is also laced with a potent toxin that will poison the foe on contact.

moveCollection.Name: Toxic
moveCollection.Effect: Badly Poison the Foe. -1 Accuracy.
moveCollection.Description: With a disgusting diet and training, the user learns how to turn its fluids into a deadly toxin.

moveCollection.Name: Transform
moveCollection.Effect: The user transforms into a copy of its target with same Ability, Attributes, Trait Modifiers, and Moves. Being inside a Pokeball breaks the Transformation.
moveCollection.Description: The user modifies its own DNA structure to become an identical clone of any Pokemon or object it can see.

moveCollection.Name: Tri Attack
moveCollection.Effect: Roll 2 Chance Dice to Paralyze the foe. Roll 2 Chance Dice to Burn the foe. Roll 2 Chance Dice to Freeze the Foe.
moveCollection.Description: The user shoots three beams. Each one is charged with a different kind of energy.

moveCollection.Name: Trick Room
moveCollection.Effect: Invert the order of Initiative. Lasts 4 Rounds.
moveCollection.Description: This reality altering move can manipulate time, so slow creatures are fast, and fast creatures are slow.

moveCollection.Name: Trick-Or-Treat
moveCollection.Effect: Add the Ghost type to Target's Type. (ie. Meowth will now by Normal/Ghost Charizard will now be Fire/Flying/Ghost) If the Pokemon already has a third type attached, replace it.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon takes the target Trick-or-Treating. The target gets a ghost costume which somehow cannot be removed without a medium's help.

moveCollection.Name: Trick
moveCollection.Effect: The foe and the user swap Held Items.
moveCollection.Description: Control the target's mind to perform a simple non-hostile action, such as walking or handling an item.

moveCollection.Name: Triple Kick
moveCollection.Effect: Successive Actions. Add 1 Extra Dice to Damage Pool to the last kick performed. -1 Accuracy.
moveCollection.Description: The user throws three or more kicks, leaving the harder blow for the end.

moveCollection.Name: Trop Kick
moveCollection.Effect: Reduce Foe's Strength.
moveCollection.Description: The user strikes with an intense and alluring kick.

moveCollection.Name: Trump Card
moveCollection.Effect: If User's Will is half spent add 1 Dice to the Damage Roll. If the User's Will is depleted add +8 to the Damage Pool.
moveCollection.Description: The more exhausted the user is, the stronger this attack will become. When the Pokemon is at the last of its strength this move can be devastating.

moveCollection.Name: Twineedle
moveCollection.Effect: Double action. Ranged. Roll 2 Chance Dice to Poison the foe per hit.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon stabs the foe with its stinger, claws or spikes infused with poison.

moveCollection.Name: Twister
moveCollection.Effect: Roll 2 Chance Dice to Flinch the foes.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon lets out a spiral current that surrounds the foes. They can't move until they free themselves from this terrible whirlwind.

moveCollection.Name: U-Turn
moveCollection.Effect: The user switches out after dealing damage. The replacement Pokemon arrives to ready to fight. Roll its initiative Switcher Move.
moveCollection.Description: The user strikes its foe, then quickly goes back to safety while another party Pokemon takes its place.

moveCollection.Name: Uproar
moveCollection.Effect: For the rest of the Round, no Pokemon can fall asleep. If a Pokemon was asleep it wakes up. Sound Based Move.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon shouts and screams and squaks so hard the noise really hurts the ears. Nobody could get a full night of sleep with all that ruckus.

moveCollection.Name: V-Create
moveCollection.Effect: Reduce the user's Dexterity, Defense, and Sp. Defense.
moveCollection.Description: The user slams its foe with a V-Shaped flame on its forehead. Upon impact, it detonates a terrible explosion and leaves the user pretty vulnerable afterwards.

moveCollection.Name: Vacuum Wave
moveCollection.Effect: Priority 1.
moveCollection.Description: The user pulls the enemy closer using the power of its ki. This traction has a lot of strength and may break anything it pulls.

moveCollection.Name: Veevee Volley
moveCollection.Effect: Add 1 Die to the Damage Roll for every point of Happiness on the User. If the user of this Move is at its Final Stage of Evolution, this move fails.
moveCollection.Description: Long sessions playing Volley ball with your Pokemon make it very happy. During battle, it just replaces the ball with its foe.

moveCollection.Name: Venom Drench
moveCollection.Effect: If an affected foe is poisoned or becomes poisoned in the same Round you used this Move then Reduce its Strength, Special, and Dexterity.
moveCollection.Description: Foes are drenched in an odd poisonous liquid that targets their weakened immune systems.

moveCollection.Name: Venoshock
moveCollection.Effect: If the Foe is already poisoned, add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon shoots a special kind of toxin that reacts violently if the foe is already weakened with poison.

moveCollection.Name: Vice Grip
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon traps the foe with its pincers or jaws and applies pressure that will leave a nasty bruise.

moveCollection.Name: Vine Whip
moveCollection.Description: They Pokemon uses its slender vines as a whip against the foe. They are as long as 20 feet.

moveCollection.Name: Vital Throw
moveCollection.Effect: Low Priority 1. Never Fail.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon awaits for the perfect moment to strike the foe.

moveCollection.Name: Volt Switch
moveCollection.Effect: The user switches out after dealing damage. The new Pokemon arrives ready to fight on the next Round. Switcher Move.
moveCollection.Description: The User quickly shoots an electic jolt, then switches places with an awaiting Pokemon partner at the speed of lightning.

moveCollection.Name: Volt Tackle
moveCollection.Effect: Recoil. Roll 1 Chance Dice to Paralyze the Foe.
moveCollection.Description: The user surrounds itself with big bolts of electricity, then it crashes against the foe.

moveCollection.Name: Wake-Up Slap
moveCollection.Effect: If the Foe is sleeping, Add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool. The foe Wakes up afterwards.
moveCollection.Description: A powerful slap that makes even the laziest Pokemon be well awake.

moveCollection.Name: Water Gun
moveCollection.Description: The user learns to shoot water with enough force to hurt the foe.

moveCollection.Name: Water Pledge
moveCollection.Effect: Creates a rainbow that adds 2 Dice to all Chance Dice rolls. This effect lasts 4 turns.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon chants to invoke the power of Water. Moisture in the air bends the light to create an inspiring rainbow. Everyone in the field is sure to give its best.

moveCollection.Name: Water Pulse
moveCollection.Effect: Roll 3 Chance Dice to Confuse the foe.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon attacks with a pulsing blast of water, this leaves the foe feeling dizzy.

moveCollection.Name: Water Shuriken
moveCollection.Effect: Ranged. Priority 1. Successive Actions.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon quickly throws sharp jets of water in the shape of a shuriken.

moveCollection.Name: Water Sport
moveCollection.Effect: For the next 4 Rounds Fire Type attacks won't add their Power to the Damage Pool.
moveCollection.Description: The user soaks the battlefield with moisture, making it harder for fire attacks to ignite.

moveCollection.Name: Water Spout
moveCollection.Effect: Remove 1 Dice of Damage for every missing HP of the User. Up to 5 Dice may be reduced this way.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon builds up an amazing pressure and releases a huge columnar vortex of water that could even reach the clouds.

moveCollection.Name: Waterfall
moveCollection.Effect: Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the foe.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon may swim with such strength that it may even swim upwards in a waterfall.

moveCollection.Name: Weather Ball
moveCollection.Effect: If the battlefield is under a Weather, add +2 to the Damage Roll and change the Type of the Move accordingly: Sun-Fire. Rain-Water. Hail-Ice. Sandstorm-Rock. Wind-Flying.
moveCollection.Description: The user creates a ball of energy that will use the climate around it to grow in size and power.

moveCollection.Name: Whirlpool
moveCollection.Effect: Block. Deal 2 dice of damage at the end of each Round. Lasts 4 Rounds. -2 Accuracy.
moveCollection.Description: Trap the foe inside a violent swirling whirlpool that makes the foe unable to escape the battle.

moveCollection.Name: Whirlwind
moveCollection.Effect: Low Priority 6. In the wild the battle ends. In an official fight, the Pokemon switches out. If it's the last or only Pokemon the move fails. Switcher Move.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon creates a powerful wind current that swirls the enemy around and sends it flying away.

moveCollection.Name: Wide Guard
moveCollection.Effect: Priority 3. Shield. Reduce 3 Damage the User and Allies would receive from a damaging move. Reduce to zero the set damage from a move the User and Allies would take.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon uses its whole body to provide coverage and protection to its allies against an incoming attack.

moveCollection.Name: Wild Charge
moveCollection.Effect: Recoil.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon surrounds itself with wild botls of lightning, then tackles recklessly.

moveCollection.Name: Will-O-Wisp
moveCollection.Effect: Burn the Foe. -2 Accuracy.
moveCollection.Description: The user calls a floating ember to consume the foe.

moveCollection.Name: Wing Attack
moveCollection.Description: The user flies towards the foe and strikes with its wings.

moveCollection.Name: Wish
moveCollection.Effect: Basic Heal. If successful spend 1 Will point to activate. The move has its effect at the beginning of the next round.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon makes a wish with all its might and somehow it becomes true.

moveCollection.Name: Withdraw
moveCollection.Effect: Increase User's Defense.
moveCollection.Description: The user hides inside its hard shell to protect itself from incoming attacks.

moveCollection.Name: Wonder Room
moveCollection.Effect: Defense and Sp. Defense will be calculated with Insight instead of Vitality. Lasts 4 Rounds.
moveCollection.Description: Inside the Wonder Room, a strong mind makes a strong body and a resilient body makes a resilient mind. However, if the mind is weak, the body will be weak and vice-versa.

moveCollection.Name: Wood Hammer
moveCollection.Effect: Recoil.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon recklessly slams the foe with a part of its rugged body, the user also gets hurt in the process.

moveCollection.Name: Work Up
moveCollection.Effect: Increase the User's Strength and Special.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon excercises with vigor to be physically and mentally prepared for battle.

moveCollection.Name: Worry Seed
moveCollection.Effect: Until the end of the Scene. Target's Ability is now "Insomnia".
moveCollection.Description: The user plants a seed in its foe. It causes a restless preoccupation that won't let it sleep at night.

moveCollection.Name: Wrap
moveCollection.Effect: Blocks. Roll 2 Dice of Damage against the foe at the end of each Round. Lasts 4 Rounds. -1 Accuracy.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon traps its foe with its body or vines, causing some damage.

moveCollection.Name: Wring Out
moveCollection.Effect: Remove 1 Dice from the Damage Roll for every missing HP of the Target. Up to 4 dice may be removed this way.
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon literally squeezes the life out of its target. As life is fading, squeezing will be harder.

moveCollection.Name: X-Scissor
moveCollection.Description: The Pokemon uses its scythes or claws as if they were a pair of scissors to cut through the foe.

moveCollection.Name: Yawn
moveCollection.Effect: If the target is not removed from battle by the start of its next Round, it will fall asleep.
moveCollection.Description: The user lets out an infectious yawn that will make anyone drowsy enough to fall asleep pretty soon.

moveCollection.Name: Zap Cannon
moveCollection.Effect: Lethal. Paralyze the Foe. -3 Accuracy.
moveCollection.Description: The user hurls a dreadful bombardment of electric explosions. Anyone hit won't be able to move for a very long time.

moveCollection.Name: Zen Headbutt
moveCollection.Effect: Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the foe. -1 Accuracy.
moveCollection.Description: The user focuses its will on its head to strike with a headbutt.

moveCollection.Name: Zing Zap
moveCollection.Effect: Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Foe.
moveCollection.Description: The user hurls itself as a zig-zaging ball of electricity that explodes on contact, this leaves the foe unable to move for a few seconds.

moveCollection.Name: Zippy Zap
moveCollection.Effect: Priority 2. This Move is always a Critical Hit and gets the proper Bonus for it. If the user of this Move is at its Final Stage of Evolution, this move fails.
moveCollection.Description: The user zips and zaps from one place to another to strike the foe moving so fast it appears to be teleporting, leaving almost no time to react.

moveCollection.Name: Growl
moveCollection.Effect: Reduce the foe's Strength. Sound Based. "Growl (Cute/Tough)", the user should use the one with highest stat (tough / cute)
moveCollection.Description: Either by a menacing attitude or cute demeanor, the foe will be unsure about attacking the user with full force.

moveCollection.Name: Raging Fury
moveCollection.Effect: Rampage.
moveCollection.Description: The user rampages and spews vicious flames to inflict damage on the target, then becomes fixated on using this move, the user is left disoriented and confused.
